dkar chag1 sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan dpal 7rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bdun pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul phrin las rdo rje mchog gis mdzod pa/ spro72 gleng brjod/ 433 sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i lam bsdus bzhugs so// 454 rig pa 'gyur me+ed ye shes kyi skyes bu chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// 477 ngo mtshar rtogs brjod brda' gsang nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'o// 41ca hor 'dul gsol 'debs dpa' bo'i gad rgyang bzhugs so// kṛ37 ge sar skyes bu chen po rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// 57ji ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba/ 79spro9

rtse gling bro bde chen rol mo bzhugs/ 811༷ rten 'brel lam yag 'cham lugs bzhugs/ 1111 seng chen ge sar rgyal po'i rtogs baji+od las/gling bro bde chen rol mo ngo mtshar shis pa'i gad rgyang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kro0312 gling rje ge sar rnam thar bsdus pa/ spro3kro13 dpal 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i rnam thar bsdus pa/ spro3spro14 rgyal zur dwa sgreng rin po che rnam thar bsdus pa/ spro4317 dwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang ngo spu+od bsdus pa/ spro471cu gling bro bde chen rol mo'i 'byung khyangs dang gzhis byes bod mi'i khrod du dar 'phel lo rgyus bsdus pa/ krospro717 thugs rje che zhu/ rwa831rngu bkra zhis/ rwa8spro1rtse 'brel yod sku dpar phyogs bsdebs/ spro87

da༅༅/ /sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/༄༅༅/ /de yang ji skad du/ mdo khams sa yi thig le 'dam stod kha shis gong du grub chen karma pak+ṣis (spro204—spro283) ge sar skyes bu don grub kyi zhal gzigs pa'i dus su mdzad par grags pa'i seng chen skyes bu don grub la bsangs gsol mchod pa 'bul tshul zhes pa las/ kyi/ chos sku dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /'od gsal lhun grub pho brang nas/ /skyabs kun 'dus sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /sku mi 'gyur 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku/ /gsung mi 'gag thugs rje chen po 'i gsung / /thugs mi 'khrul phyag na rdo rje thugs/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i skye ba yin/ /rigs lnga thugs kyi sprul pa yin/ /sa bcu non pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /dbu nag bod kyi lha skal yin/ /thabs kyi 'gro don byed pa'i mchog /skye 'gro yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu/ /'dzam gling mun pa gsal byed pa/ /seng chen nor bu don 'grub kyi/ /bsangs dang sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ zhes dang /dge rgyal bsod nams tshe brtan gyi bskul ngor 7rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa theg mchog rdo rjes (kro797—kro867) mdzad pa'i ge sar bsangs 2spro

gling bro bde chen rol mo/mchod las/ hūm̐/ yul ni mthong ba kun smon na/ /rgya bod yongs kyi dgra lha che/ /pad 'byung 'phrin las pho nya ste/ /nag po bdud kyi kha gnon dang //ser po hor gyi gnya' gnon mchog /seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul ni//zhes dang /yang de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ge sar skyes bu 'khor bcas dgyes par byed pa'i mchod gtor nor bu'i rgyal mtshan las kyang / khyad par mchod pa'i yul dam pa/ /pad 'byung phrin las bdag nyid che/ /gangs can bod kyi dgra lha'i gtso/ /seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul mchod/ ces dang / khyad par snyigs ma'i rang mdangs kyi/ /lha srin 'khrug pa'i byol ba dang / /dam sri 'byung po'i rgyu lam chod/ /rdzogs ldan nor bu'i dpal spros shig /ces dang / seng chen nor bu dagla 'dul rtsal/ /skyes bu chen po mi'i ge sar/ /deng sang stigs ma lnga bdo 'dir/ /dam sri 'byung po kha dar zhing / khyad par smon log bdud rje'i 'phrul/ /log bshes gdug pa'i rgyal 'bangs rnams/ /sdig sbyod mi dge'i bya ba 'phel/ /bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar zhing / /rgyal khams sdug la 'dres dus 'dir/ /bdud rje'i srog bdag khyod min nam/ /hor po'i gshed po khyod min nam/ /bskos pa'i mi chen khyod min nam/ /btsugs

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/pa'i shing ring khyod min nam/ /'phrul gyi mi'u khyod min nam/ /smon lam mtha' btsan khyod min nam/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs lngan khyod min nam//yongs la dbang bsgyur khyod min nam/ zhes dang /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mi pham rin po ches (spro846—kro9spro2)mdzad pa'i ge sar rdo rje tshe'i rgyal po'i gzhung dang man ngag gi skor bdud rtsi'i bum bzang las/ khyad par ma 'ongs nyi shu'i mthar thug skabs: dregs pa'i tshul ston ge sar skyes bu zhes: phyi ru dpa' zhing rtsal myur dgra lha'i rgyal: nang du snying nye bkra shis 'khu ldog chung :khyad par dam sri rgya 'dre 'dul ba'i gnyen: deng sang dus su bab pa'i lhag lha ste: zhes dang / 'dis kyang dam sri gsar skyes rgya 'dre 'gong po tsha ngar chog cing chos mthun gyi bsam rgu yid bzhin tu 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dang /yang mi pham rin po ches mdzad pa'i dag snang chos skor las skyes bu ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal po'i gsang mdos dam can dgyes skong rtsa ba bzhugs: zhes pa las/ ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe: skye 'gro'i bya sbyod ngan pa'i 'bras: nad yams 'khrug rtsod sad ser dang : mi 'dod sna tshogs phyur gyis 'ong : khyad par nag phyogs rgya 'dre'i rigs:23

gling bro bde chen rol mo/gangs ljongs ser skya'i khong zhugs nas: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i thugs dgongs dkrugs: chos dang srid kyi khrims kha bshig: nang nas 'khrug cing mtha' la g.yab: lho dang zhub nas khrag mtsho khol:sh-ir phyogs rang don rang mgo 'khor: rgya nag khri yi zur nas ral:phas rgol mtshon rtse gzengs pa la: bzlog thabs dus bab zab mo'i chos: skyes bu ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal: dgyes skong gsang mdos cho ga bstan: zhes dang /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos (182gyod1892) mdzad pa'i sku rje ge sar rgyal po'i gsol mchod shin tu bsdus pa bkra zhis kyi sgra dbyangs las/ khyad par lha gcig khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /bod khams bde la 'god pa'i phrin las kyi/ /sku lha ge sar skyes bu don grub sogs/ /mched 'khor sprul dang yang sprul bcas pa kun/ zhes dang /mi pham rin po ches mdzod pa'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub la sa/ rang bzhin skye me+ed chos kyi dbyings las/ rnam rol 'gag med thugs rje'i rtsal snang / rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dang rigs gsum zhi khro'i sgyu 'phrul gcig tu 'dus pa/ ge sar skyes bu chen po rig 'dzin nor bu dgra 'dul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ yi dam zhi khro'i 24

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/khyab bdag /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje/ chos skyong srung ma'i gtso bo/nor lha rgya mtsho'i snying nor/ dgra bla yongs kyi rgyal po/ /wer ma yongs kyi srog snying / sde brgyad yongs kyi spyi rje/ dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag /dkar phyogs yongs kyi kha 'dzin/ skye bo yo ngas kyi dgra bla/sems can yongs kyi dpal mgon/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing /ban bon yongs kyi rgyab brten/ bdud 'dul las kyi dbang phyug /nag phyogs kun gyi gshed ma/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ bdud srin kun gyi zhan pa chen po/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mdor na dkar phyogs yongs kyi pho lha/ wer ma yongs kyi spyi rje/ rgya 'dre 'gong po'i kha gnon/btsan po'i gnya' gnon/ nyam chung skyong ba'i pha ma/ mtha' dmag gdug pa'i kha gnon/ rigs gsum pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul/ gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul zhes pa ni/ji ltar mgon po 'bri gung gi dpal rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i (1597——1659) rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa srong po'i dga' ston las/ byang rta nar 'byor ba'i tshe gling gi dpa' brtul sum cu gling rje ge sar dang bcas pas bzhengs pa'i 'bum mjal ba na/ ge sar gyis bzhengs pa'i 'bum gyi kha byang du/ ge sar khri srong lje btsan yin/2 25

gling bro bde chen rol mo//mchod gnas slob dpon pad+ma yin/ /'brug mo ye shes mtsho rgyal yin/zhes dang /kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i (1698—spro755) zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che byang phyogs su byung ba'i rtsa lag bod rje btsan po'i gdung rabs chig nyung don gsal me long las/gling rje ge sar du grags pa yang gnam lde 'od srung nas 'di yab sras kyi ring la byung bar mngon la/ rlangs kyi a me+es byang chub 'dre bkol gyi sbyin bdag ge sar gyis byas shing / byang chub 'dre bkol rang nyid gu ru pad ma'i sprul pa dang / ge sar khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sprul par khas blangs shing / ge sar lo gya brgyad thub pa'i lung bstan mdzod tshul rlangs kyi po ti bse rur yod pas/ ge sar nam byung gi dus des shes pas de las dus snga ba dang phyi bar ma sems shig /ces dang /mgo log a lcags 'bru rigs gyi lung bkra shis rgya mtsho dang gyi lung thugs mchog rdo rje zung gis dus rabs bcu dgu'i stod char brtsams pa'i bod mi bu gdong drug gi rus mdzod me tog skyed tshal las/ khyad par du bar khams kyi sa cha 'di ni/ sa yi cha gling gi yul zhes pa ni sgang drug las zal mo'i sgang du grags pa 'di la gling khri 26

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/gong 'og bar gsum/ gling khri gong ma'i sa ni khams stod 'bri klung gi sa cha rnams dang / de las bhe sgom gyi rdza ri de'i phu na rdza g.ya' brag dang / gangs brag g.ya' bya ba'i ri khrod ngo mtshar can yod pa/ mda' na mi sde gong zi/ mang 'brug gnyis kyi dpon chen gling sa ldong seng blon yin la/ seng blon gyi bu che ba rgya tsha zhal dkar sogs yin pa 'og nas 'chad la/ gling khri bar ma'i sa cha ni zhar zla rol gyi sa cha rnams dang /gling khri 'og ma'i sa cha ni mdo khams smar rol yin par bzhad la/ gling khri zhes pa ni mi sde khri tsho re'i bdag po yin la/ khri dmag gsum gyi dpung gi bdag po yin pas de ltar grags so/ kha cig gling khri 'og ma ni lha ldong be ri'i sa cha dag yin par 'chad do/ /ldong gling ba de la che rgyud dang / 'bring rgyud dang / chung rgyud dang gsum yod pa'i lo rgyus thams cad ni gling gi sgrung yig khungs dag rnams su gsal zhing /'di'i che rgyud kyi dpon stag rong gi gzig 'phan/ 'bring rgyud kyi dpon po 'bri rong gi stag lha/ chung rgyud kyi dpon po bla rong a myes khya rgan khro bo 'di ni bon po'i rig 'dzin zhig yin la/ de'i steng du btsad po dbu rigs kyi sa stag nam mkha' gzungs dang / rlangs ston pa ar mi dbang phyug byang chub kyi drung nas chos dang / 'chi med tshe yi dbang

gling bro bde chen rol mo/mchog dang gdams pa zab mo thob pa zhig yin zhing tshe shin tu ring ba'i tshad cig yin pas khro rgan zer zhing / ming dngos la khro bo skyabs zhes zer ba de yin/ 'di'i bu che ba khro bo 'phan ni khro thung yin/ 'bring ba seng blon dang / chung ba snang chung g.yu stag yin/ seng blon gyi rgya bza'i bu rgya tsha ni ge khod rgyal dang / 'gag mo'i bu ge khod skyabs yin la 'di ni chung ngu'i dus nas pho rtsal sna dgu dang ldan pas seng chen 'dra zhes pas seng chen dang / ge sar dang /rjes nas sa yi cha gling gi yul 'di thams cad kyi bdag po rgyal por gyur pas 'dzam gling gi rgyal po ltar yin zhes 'dzam gling rgyal po seng chen zer bar grags pa de'i btsun mo sga skya lo'i bya mo 'byag mo yin pa 'di yang lcol ba'i byad med yin la/ gtso bo gling rje ge sar 'di dang 'khor phya zhu dpa' thil can sum cu sogs thams cad dang / blon po ni gling chung rgyud 'di yi tsha bo dang zhang po gnyis kar gyur ba'i sga dpa' thil tsha zhang 'dan ma sbyang khra dang / sbra dpa' yang thil skyes mchog thar pa dang / sbra skyes mchog sbra tsha shar yag dang / sbra a bse skyen po mtheb drug rnams blon chen yin/ de rnams ni dus skabs der bod yul gyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi dad cing gnod par byed pa'i hor gangs ri rgyal po 28

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/'khor dang bcas pa dang / byang phyogs kyi srin po bdud mi yi rdzus zhugs kyi rdzu 'phrul can bdud rgyal rgan po pha bu 'khor bcas 'dul ba'i ched du sangs rgyas kyis sprul pa'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyi sprul pa kho na yin la/ khyad par du gling rje ge sar ni rlangs ston pa ar mi byang chub 'dre bkol gyi dam pa'i chos kyi slob mar gyur pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po yin la/bon gyi grub thob chen po yang yin pas gnam sngon rgyal mo dang / rma rgyal spom ra dang / a bo ger mdzo sogs yul lha rnams kyis kyang sdong grogs mdzad pa la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med zer ro/ /zhes dang /zhig mad brag dgan zhabs drung dkan mchag bstan par rab rgyas (1801—1866) zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i yul mdo smad kyi ljongs su thub bstan rin po che ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsal bar brjod pa deb ther rgya mtsho las/ sngon ma 'gram stod kyi sa thams cad la gling rje ge sar rgyal pos dbang bsgyur/ de nyid kyi 'khrungs lo lcags byi (spro000)dang chu sprul (992) la 'dod mkhan gnyis snang ba gang yin yang rab byung dang po tshugs kha ma'i drug cu skor der gtogs la/ rlangs byang chub 'dre bkol dang / spyi ti dz+nyā na gīrti spyan drangs te chos zhus pa 29

gling bro bde chen rol mo/dang gtsug lag khang bzhengs par bzhad pas kyang shes zhus/ zhes dang /skyabs rje bdud 'joms 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes (kro904—kro986)mdzad pa'i gangs ljongs rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi phyi mo snga 'gyur bstan pa rin po che ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dag cing gsal bar brdzod pa lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs las/ rab byung gnyis pa zhar ba na/ gling rje ge sar sa stag (spro038) lnga bcu tham pa/zhes gsal ba ltar 'dir sku 'khrungs pa'i dus rabs bstan pa'o//kun gzigs byams mgon si tu paṇa chen (1700waspro774) gyi rang rnam rang tshul drang por brjod pa'i dri bral shel gyi me long las/ de nas rang lo bcu dgu pa'i dbyar thog der tshab tsha bla mas nan gyis yong dgos phebs pa ltar zhar zla'i phyogs su phyin/ nam mdor tshab tsha bla ma dpon slob rnams bsu bar 'byor/ zhag zhas bsdad khrom dbang bgyis/mdzes mdar kam tshe ring gis mgo mi byas te khrom pa dag 'dug par khrom dbang dang / chos khri khar dngos po byin pa rnams blangs shing khrom la dge bskul spyi dang khyad par yig drug dung phyur sgrub pa'i khas len byed du bcug pa sogs sngar rgyun bzhin bgyis nas zhwa dmar bgo ba 30

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/dang yig drug gi bzlas lung bsngo smon dang bcas pa sogs 'dod pa skong ci thub byas/ de bzhin khrom bzang ba tsho dung mdar 'dus par khrom dbang dge bskul sogs sngar bzhin dang / lci mda' ste gling rje ge sar 'khrungs pa'i gnas yin zhes pa der a phyug gi 'brog pa tsho dang /stag dgon pa'i khrod du'ang rib tsam bcas snga ma bzhin khrom dbang dge bskul zhwa dmar 'go ba sogs ci lcogs ci nus drel 'tshub bgyis/ zhes dang /7rgyal mchog bcu bzhi pa theg mchog rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'dzom gling bod kyi dgra lha ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi bsang mchod bdud rtsi'i char rgyun las/ kyi/ 'dzom gling lho phyogs kha ba can/ /gdong dmar bod yul shar gyi phyogs/ /gser lngan chu bo'i g.yas phyogs na//mthong ba kun smon zhes grags pa'i/ /ngo mtshar yul ljongs nyams dga' ba/ /de na 'dzam gling bod kyi lha/ /rgya bod yongs kyi dagla lha che//seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul ni/ zhes dang mdzad byang du'ang / karma pa bcu bzhi pas 'dzam gling skyes bu 'khrungs pa'i yul sngats+tsha chos 'khor rnam rgyal gling gi nye char bris pa bkra shis/ zhes dang /mchog gling pad+ma kun khyab ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i ge sar 3spro

gling bro bde chen rol mo/skyes bu don 'grub kyi sgrub thabs grub gnyis daphyid ster las bzhi lhun 'grub las/ kyi: 'dzam gling gangs can bod kyi ljongs: yul la g.yang chags zhar zla sgang : skyed sos yag pa'i sum mdo la:dgra lha sku gcig skyes pa ni: ge sar skyes bu don grub ces: mtshan dkar ba dan srid rtser bsgreng : dbu nag bod kyi rgyal por bskos:zhes dang /phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba mi pham 'jam dpal rdo rje'i zhal lung ji lta bar/ shākya'i dge sbyong pad+ma dri me+ed blo gros kyis mdzod pa'i 'dzam gling ge sar skyes bu'i rtogs baji+od las/ 'khrungs gling me tog gi ra ba dang rma sa bzung dar gyi mdud pa las/ sa 'di skyid sos yag gi mdo/ /chu gnyis chab ma brdab 'dra yod/ /brag gnyis mda' sgro gshib 'dra yod/ /spang gnyis bal stan bting 'dra yod/ /brag sbal pa 'dra ba'i rtsa ba red/ ces dang / gong gsal 'khrungs gling me tog gi ra ba dang rma sa bzung dar gyi mdud pa las/zhag gsum gyi snga bar stag rong a khu khro thung de rta gu gu rog rdzong la zhon/ mar dkar gyi spu lu/ sbrang bu ram gyi mngar zhim mang po khyer/ de rnams la rgya dug yu mo rgyug 'gyel de btab ste bu la rkan mar gyi 32

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/tshab tu khyer te/ lci sug gnyis kyi mdor 'gog mo ma bu'i rtsar 'ong nas/ a re dga'/ 'gog mo la bu yod pa 'di nga a khya'i tsha bo yin/da lta zhag gsum las ma song ba la lo gsum gyi tshad tsam rdzogs 'dug/gdong smug po'i rgyud pa la de 'dra los yod/ces dang /yang de nyid las/ de'ang 'dir 'khrungs gling mi 'dra ba bzhi lnga tsam mjal rung / la lar ni rang bzos bslad bcug pa dang / la lar ni bris nor rgyun 'byams song 'dug pa sogs 'khrugs sdeb bsal cing khyad par du'ang 'khrungs yul lci sug tu ngos 'dzin pa 'di'ang skyes chen du ma'i dgongs pa dang bstun nas/ rgya bza'i sbra mal dang / klu gtsug na'i chu mig /zhig mye sgom pa'i sgrub phug sogs mngon rtags dang sbyar nas/zhes dang /rje btsun smra ba'i seṅge'i rnam rol 7mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i ngo mtshar rtogs brjod brda gsang nor bu'i me long gi gnad 'gag don 'grel gyi rnam thar dang bstun nas/ rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje/ (spro842—spro924) gter chen las rab gling pa (spro856—spro926) sogs mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor 'chang ba'i ban hūl ku sa li arak+ṣa mu ṇi zha sa 33

gling bro bde chen rol mo/nas bris pa'i gling dkar rta rgyug rtogs brjod las skyes mchog ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi rnam thar snyan pa'i ba dan ngo mtshar cha bdun phye ste nor bu'i me long las/shar khra mo gling dkar stod kyi/lci sos yag gi kha mdo ru/ klu gnyan mi gsum bshos pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/zhes gsal ba ltar mdo khams rdza khog skyid sos sam lci sos yag gi kha mdor sku 'khrungs shing / sku tshe stod rma khog tu gzhis spos nas brtul zhugs spyod pas mdzad 'phrin ci rigs bskyangs nas bzhugs/gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i thun mong dang thun min mdzod/ pa rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i sgrung yig la'ang srid le dang / lha gling / 'khrungs gling /ma sa bzung / rta rgyugs/ phyogs bzhi bdud bzhi dang /rdzong chen 1rnguphyi gling 21 rdzong chung rtsi rtsi grangs med cham la phab rjes/ mthar dmyal gling rdzogs pa chen po nas mjug bsdu ba bcas las rgyas par mkhyen rgyu/lhag par du'ang deng sang 'dzam gling go la gyil po'i nang gling rje ge sar gyi dpa' bo'i sgrung yig dag ni 'dzam gling yongs nang ring zhos dang da dung rdzogs mtha' med par gson nyams dod pos le'u gsar pa ci rigs sgrung mkhan dag gis mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud grol nas sngar 34

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/med ming thos tsam yang med pa'i rdzong chen mang po phab bzhin pa tsam du ma zad phyi lo 2༷༷rtse nas bzung 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i shes rig tshan rtsal rig gzhung sde tshan (6khosbyi5bhudu) gyi mngon me+ed shul bzhag gi rig gzhung ( kha5kro2ba 2rdu1sabh+ya 1ba(mababh+ya161khu bhu51(khu1ma1khakhusmo1(lnga6khu sbyi15( ) gi tho khongs su tshud pa bcas ni gangs can bod pa'i spyi nor khyad 'phags ngoms su chog pa zhig los yin/gling rje ge sar dang dpa' brtul pha khu mo sman rnams kyi pha zog g.yang rdzas ji snyed cig bod chol gsum gang sar dad rten du bzhugs bzhin pa nas sgrub brgyud karma kai tshang gi gdan sa chen mo mtshur mdo bo lung du bzhugs gsol kha cig dus 'gyur rjes byes kyi gdan sa rum bteg karma bzhad sgrub chos 'khor gling gi 7rgyal mchog 7yid bzhin nor bu'i gzim chung tshoms chen du rten gri gsum yod khongs nas 'bru sga bde chos skyong ber nag gi phyag zhan se ral reg gcod dang / yang phu bo rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi phyag zhan ya gzi dkar phran nam/kha zhas kyi dung skyong dpon gyi gri red ces zer srol 'dug kyang lo rgyus dngos la rma rgyal spom ra nas karma pa la phul ba'i gling ge sar rgyal po'i phyag shan zhes pa zhig 'dug cing / gri 'di gnyis kyi go tshad ha 35

gling bro bde chen rol mo/cang ring po dang / nang gri lcags rgyu ni gnam lcags dkar po dang /phyi shun bzo khyad ha cang gi ngo mtshar can rin po che sna lnga rim pa ltar bsgrigs pa la spu+os can zhig dang / gri de gnyis las go tshad cung thung ba can zhig 'dug /de ni lha sras dgra lha rtse rgyal gzhon skabs kyi phyag shan rtse lha bcu gsum zer ba de red/ nang gri ngos gcig la ri yi ri mo mi 'dra ba rtse mo bcu gsum gyi rang byon dang ngos gzhan ma la dug sgrul gnyis gzhib thur rgyugs kyi ri mo yod pa can zhig yod/ mgon khang chen mo'i spyan gzigs kyi gras su/ ri pa bag yod gong mar gzhi bdag mthu chen zhig gis phul bar grags pa'i lngong chos lu bu yi dar 'phen gyi phyag zhan dam nyams srog gcod ces grags pa zhig dang /de bzhin rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rjer rma rgyal spom ra nas phul ba'i 'dan ma'i phyag zhan 'jang pa yu dmar dang / yang rgyal dbang theg mchog rdo rjer dpa' mo a stag klu mo nas dngos su phul ba'i dpa' mo'i phyag zhan gser thig bdun pa/ dpa' la mi sbyang dkar po'i phyag zhan mtshon leb chen bdud kyi bshas gri bcas yod/spyir skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu phyogs phebs skabs/ rag dung 'bud mkhan gnyis nas bshan pa'i dug ral dang / 'abhu sga bde'i phyag shan ser ral reg 36

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/gcod gnyis 'khur dgos kyi yod 'dug cing / rgyal mchog sku gong ma phyi lo 1rtse47 lor bal yul gnas gzigs phebs lam bal yul spog rar de skabs rag dung ba 'jam dbyangs nor 'phel zer ba nas dug ral 'bar ba bor brlag gis/rjes sor gdan sar 'byor skabs nyes chad lo mang kho pa nas ja 'dren byas pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pa rgan rabs ngag rgyun ltar dang /kar rabs bcu bzhi pa chen po yang gling rje ge sar dang gdung rus gcig mtshungs spug po ldong gi brgyud du ri che zla nang dpon tshang du sku 'khyungs pa dang / rgyal dbang bco lnga pa mkha' khyab rdo rje (187spro—kro922)mchog gi sku tshe gcig ring gling rje ge sar gyi rnam thar gsan pa/ra shin tu dgyes sbro yod stabs ri pa bag yod sku phreng bdun pa kam sgrub brgyud 'phrin las rab rgyal gyis ge sar chos sgrung phul skor bag yod rnam thar dad gsum pad+mo bzhad pa'i bdud rtsi'i nang gsal bas mtshon gling che 'bring chung gsum gyi dpa' brtul sum cu dang / yang thul dam pa'i mi bdun/ zhe thul khra glag sbyang gsum sogs kyi sku thang grwa tshar zhal bkod dang dod chen po mdzod par grags/ rgyal dbang gong ma rig pa'i rdo rje'i (1924—kro981) yab 'dan khog a thub sras po tshe 37

gling bro bde chen rol mo/dbang phun tshogs kyang shin tu sgrung dga' chen po yin zhing / a thub pho brang nang rdzong chen bco brgyad kyi phyag dpe cha tshang bzhugs su gsol ba dang kha cig gis bzhad srol ltar na 'ju mi pham gyis ljags sgrig gling bro yang 'dan a thub pho brang nang 'khrab srol btsugs skad/ rgyal dbang rig pa'i rdo rje'ang gling rje ge sar sgrung yig la shin tu thugs mos che zhing lcags 'brug 1khye4༷ lor stsal ba'i gsung mgur las/mi nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na/ /'dan shug ra skyid kyi yar nang nas/ /shug ra skyid kyi mar nang nas/ /shug ra gnyis kyi bar mtshams na/ /tsha zhang 'dan ma'i bu brgyud la/ /ming bos na thub bstan dge legs zer/zhes gsungs pa dang / skabs su bab pa'i snang glu rkang drus/ bung ba'i lding dbyangs kyis gtsos sku na phra skabs ge sar chos sgrung sil ma ltar du gnang ba'i gsung mgur mang dag bzhugs skad/ dus 'gyur skabs mtshur phu'i phyag sku nas ge sar sgrung yig drel rgyab gcig 'bras ljongs nang gdan zhu gnang ba'i grags pa che/smar khams ke re'i lha sgang ring mo'i 'dab rol kho bo'i skyed byed lha thog ba gor ru ba'i tshe dang lngan pa karma don grub bkra this kyang rtag tu ge sar sgrung yig 'don rgyu dang nyan rgyur dga' mos che zhing / gling rje 38

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/ge sar sgrub thabs las tshogs sogs la mos gus dag snang can zhig yod pa da lta'ang lhang nger dran pa bcas zhor 'phros so//skabs su bab par 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos 'ju mi pham rin po che'i (spro846—1912) dgongs gter las byon pa'i gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i dag snang chos skor las gling bro bde chen rol mo zhes par le'u tshan bzhi dang rten 'brel lam yag ces pa'i le tshan gcig bcas mdzod pa rnams rtsa bar byas te/ bod kyi srid skyong rgyal zur dwa sgreng sku phreng lnga pa rin po ches (rwa9rwa2—spro947) gling khro'i srub 'jug kha skong zhus te le'u 12 kyi bdag nyid can mdzad cing nyid kyis skyong 'os gdan sa dwa sgreng dgon par 'khrab srol dbya 'byed gnang skabs rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po ches bro dpon du mdo khams sgom sde nang chen nas yin pa'i stag gsar tshang nor bzang lags bsko bzhag dang 'brel phal cher 1rtse47bar lo zhas 'khrab ston zhus tshod/chab srid dus 'gyur dbang gis rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang rgya gar du 'byor rjes dang thog rgya gar lho zhar o re sa phun tshogs gling gzhis sgar du gtso bo snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po ches bka' 'brel dbugs dbyung gis rgyal zur dwa sgreng rin po 39

gling bro bde chen rol mo/ches phyogs bsgrigs gling khro'i bstan pa'i me ro bskyar gso gnang 'dug/rim pa'i rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang nas brgyud pa'i gling bro tshogs khag o re sa gzhis chags dang / bal yul rgyal sa/ rgya gar shar phyogs a ru na cal mnga' sde'i ṭu ṭing sogs gang sar khyab brdal byung ba dang / lhag par du mdo khams tsha stod ri dgon bkra shis chos gling gi ri bla'i gdung 'dzin lcam dral rnams nas kyang rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang nas brgyud pa'i gling bro gzhis byes gnyis su rgyun mthud dar spel mdzad 'dugad cha dwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang gi bu mo dbyangs 'dzoms dang skal bzang chos sgron/ tsha mo kun bzang dpal mo dang tshe g.yang sgrol ma bcas mi thog gsum gyis gling bro'i brgyud 'dzin gson nyams lngan par mu mthud gnang mu sa su yin 'dug pa yid r+gha'i gnas su mchis/deng 'dir tshe g.yang sgrol mas 'gan 'khyar nas gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal gyi rtogs brjod las/gling bro bde chen rol mo zhes pa'i rtsa ba dang srub 'jug gi bro tshig dang /bod gzhis byes gnyis su 'khrab ston dar 'phel byung tshul lo rgyus mdor bsdus dkar phyogs 40

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' skad g.yu 'brug ldir sgra zhes pa phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba ni dus thog mkho nges gang legs byung 'dug pa rjes su yi rang dang / ma 'ongs par yang rang re'i rig gzhung rtsa che khungs dag rnying pa'i rigs spyi dang bye brag gling bro lta bu mi nyams rgyun 'dzin sngar mus bzhin mdzod gal che zhes 'bod bskul zhu rgyu/gling bro bde chen rol mo 'di ni 'jig rten pa'i dga' skyo dang rtsed mtshar gyi glu bro dang mi 'dra ba rnal 'byor bla med rgyud kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs nang gses gar dang / 'cham/ stangs stabs/ phya ga rgya/phyag mtshan/ 'don rta dbyangs dang 'brel mtshungs shig yin/dpal zhwa lu pa'i mkhas pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzod pa'i stangs stabs kyi man ngag gar mkhan rnam rol las/ rig 'dzin sde snod sgor zhugs nas/ /dkyil 'khor las rim cho ga la/ /sngon du sa yi cho ga'i dus//stangs stabs rgyas bsdus ci rigs sam//de las gzhan du bgegs 'joms dang / /tshar gcod tsham rngam la sogs/ pa/ /gar gyi cho ga la gzhol ba'i/ /dang po'i las can skye bo rnams/ /man ngag 'di yi gnad rig pas/ /mi brnyas dwang du blangs gyur na/ /pha rol khrom tshogs zil gyis non/ /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog brjid cing mdzes ya rabs ngo 4spro

gling bro bde chen rol mo/mtshar lhag par dga'/ /rang gis mi 'jigs gdeng rnyed dang / /kun gyis bsngags pa'i 'os su 'gyur/ zhes dang / rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzod pa'i dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'cham gyi brjed byang lha'i rol gar las/ de yang lag stabs gtso che ba la gar/ rkang stabs gtso che ba la 'cham/ de gnyis ka gtso che ba stangs stabs zhes bzhad pas/ gnas skabs su mi 'dra ba 'dra zhig mchis kyang / don lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas 'phrin las sgrub pa la mi 'gal lo//lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ 'gying ba/ sprug pa sogs phyag rgya mkhas pa'i man ngag dang lngan zhing / ngag sngags kyi bzlas pa rgyun mi chad pa dang /yid lha gang dang gi nga rgyal brtan po 'dzin cing / de thams cad kyang gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa lta bas rgyas thebs pa zhig dgos pas/tshe 'di'i rnyed grags chos brgyad kyi ched kho na dang / ltad mo dang rtsed mo tsam gyi ched du bya ba'i tha mal gyi sbyod tshul dang mtshungs pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang /spyir bzo la lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzo gsum du stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs la/ phyag rgya'i gar 'chams 'di nyid la lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzo gsum ga tshang ba 42

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/yin te/ lus kyi bzo ni mngon sum du grub cing / ngag gi bzo ni gsang sngags kyi sgra grag stong skye ba med pa'i tshul du bzla/ yid kyi bzo ni lha'i bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal gsal snang dang ma bral bas so//zhes dang /ding sang gsang sngags kyi phyag len sogs mi shes par lto phyir du snang ba la gang sh-ir gyi gar 'cham byas nas gzhan mgo bskor ba rnams kyi ngang tshul la brten/ gar 'cham ltad mo dang rtsed mo lta bu yin snyam pa gtan nas mi bya'o//gling bro 'khrab pa'i phan yon ni ji skad du mi pham rin po che'i gsung gling bro bde chen rol mo las/ bro yi dga' ston 'dir 'brel bar/ /ltad mo rnam pa sna tshogs bya/ /'dus pa rnams kyis seng chen rje//dran pas gsol 'debs dbyangs snyan bsgrags/ /des ni gnas skabs dga' ba dang / yun du chos srid legs tshogs 'phel/ /rten 'brel bzang po'i sgo 'phar dbye/ /bkra shis don grub phyogs las rgyal/ zhes dang /snga 'gyur rdzogs sbrul lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes (spro872—1935) phyogs bsgrigs 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i stag gzig rdzong 43

gling bro bde chen rol mo/gi nor 'gyed las/ stag gling dpa' bo g.yul 'gyed skabs gzhan la med pa'i nor 'gyed/ g.yang rab dam pa'i sgo mo/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i mdzod chos/ 'khor ba'i bstan chos kyi gzhi rtsa/ sgang pa bod la dgos bzhin du chad lus med pa bkod pa 'di/bla ma mi dpon ser skya pho mo sus 'gri klog 'don gsum rtsa 'dzin byas na/ g.yang skyabs g.yang sgrub tshad ldan re bgyis pa dang khyad med yin pa kun nas nges so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / lhag par snyigs ma'i mthar thug dus gu ru rin po che'i thugs rje'i phrin las kyi rol gar gnyis su med pa'i gling rje ge sar gyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs/phrin las dngos grub sogs myur bas gling dre'i bro pa pho mo rnams kyis dad dam rnam par dag pa'i blos 'khrab ston bgyid na gzhis byes kun tu kha 'dzin sdong grogs 'go ba/ nad mug mtshon 'khrugs 'jigs pa zhi ba/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags stobs 'byor 'phel ba/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar dang bstan 'dzin sku tshe sring ba/ char chu dus babs btsa' sad ser ba srung ba/ rta phyugs 'bru nor phywa g.yang longs spyod 'phel ba/mdor na yid la smon cing dge ba'i don mtha' dag 'bad med myur ba nyid du 'grub pa dang / mthar thug bde ba mchog gi dngos grub thob pa/44

sngon du gleng ba'i gtam/bkra shis dpal gyis rtag tu khyab pa bcas kyi phan yon nam dge mtshan che'o/ /deb 'di'i glong brjod zhig 'bri dgos zhes gling bro 'khrab ston pa tshe g.yang sgrol mas bskul ngor karma pa'i mtshan gyi yi ges brjid pa/ o rgyan phrin las su 'bod pa'i gyi na ba des chu pho 'brug zla rtse pa/phyi lo 3༷12 zla 1༷ tshes 1ca la dha sa rgyud stod grwa tshang gi yang steng du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//

༄0/ /gleng brjod/da༅༅/ /gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal gyi rtogs brjod las gling bro bde chen rol mo zhes pa 'jam mgon mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsho mchog gi dag snang gi chos sde las byon pa'i thog /rgyal zur dwa sgreng mchog gi zur 'jug kha bsnon bcas yod pa 'byung khungs lo rgyus bsdus pa 'di/ rang gzhan nyams len pa rnams dang phyis 'byung gzhon skyes tsho la cung zad phan phyir dmigs nas phyogs bsdebs bgyis dus rang nyid rnam dpyod kyi 'jug sgo dman pas mkhas pa'i spobs pa med kyang / lhag bsam sems bskyed stobs kyis rang blos dpog tshod kyi sgo nas phyogs bsgrigs 'di smug po ldong rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang gi sras mo dbyangs 'dzoms lags dang /skal bzang chos sgron lags/ sde dge bkra zhis rdo rje lags kyis gtsos sku bgres rnams la bka' 'dri nyams zhib byas rtogs ltar/ bod ljongs nang chos rig gzhung la zhabs tog dang khyad par du rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyi bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bro dpon nor bzang brgyud 'dzin pa nyid kyi sras mo dbyangs 'dzoms dang skal bzang chos 47

gling bro bde chen rol mo/sgron rnam gnyis kyi re 'dun bzhin gling bro'i 'byung khungs dang brgyud 'dzin gyi lo rgyus bsdus pa sh-i+og grangs mang po med kyang da bar yig thog tu cha tshang 'khod med pa'i stabs kyi dgos pa khyad par can gyi phyir kho mo tshe g.yang sgron ma nas brgyud 'dzin 'gan rkang len zhus bzhin bstan 'gro'i don dang khyad par du gsang sngags zab mo'i brgyud pa'i byin rlabs yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu gyur cig

bco〉༅/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi'i lam bsdus bzhugs so//bco〉༅/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ na mo pu dzā hoḥ tsos badz+ra satā uḥdage la yi rang chos 'khor skor zhing bzhugs/ /kun tu bzang po yongs bsngo 'grub par zhog /chos nyid mi 'gyur snang ba mtha' yas dang / 'gag med snying rje longs spyod spyan ras gzigs/ /o rgyan pad 'byung brdzus skyes sbrul pa'i sku/ /gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon bar chad sol/ /'chi khar mnar gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /tshe 'di'i snang ba hūṃb par gyur ma thag/bde ba can dang ri bo po tā la/ /zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor skye bar shog/oṃ uḥhūm̐ oṃ āḥmi dhe wa h+phiḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/oṃ āḥhūm̐/oṃ uḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūm̐/ces pa'ang rgan gzhon rnams kyi don du mkhyen brtse lhas so////49

༄༅༅/ /rig pa 'gyur me+ed ye shes kyi skyes bu chen po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs sa//༄༅༅/ /e ma ho/ mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong //lha rtsa gsum dagla bla'i sgrin phung dbus/ /pha skyes mchog nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal/ /byin thibs se dgyes zhal ngoms bzhin bzhugs//mgon rgyal ba kun 'dus thugs rje can/ /dpal o rgyan chen po'i sbrul pa'i sku/ /rje rigs gsum gcig 'dus seng chen rgyal/ /bu mos gus bzod me+ed gdung shugs kyis/ /pha khyod la gsol ba snying nas 'debs/ /thugs 'od gsal 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang / /byams snying rje'i sgrin chen rtag tu 'khrigs/ /las smon lam mthun pa'i gdul bya la//byin btsan thabs 'debs pa'i thugs rje can//dpal dgra bla'i sku chas re rer yang / /lha rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor grangs las 'das//dran tsam gyis byin rlabs dbang chen thob/ /yab dpa' bo'i bro bdungs khrabs se khrab//yum dpa' mo'i glu len sha ra ra//rta rdo rje'i he sgra lhangs se lhang / /dpa' dgra bla'i bzhad sgra chems se chem sems 51

gling bro bde chen rol mo/mos gdung can gyi skye bo la/ /da ma g.yel ma g.yel byin gyis rlobs//lus 'di la dgra bla'i dpa' rdzong chos/ /ngag 'di la 'phrul gsung dbang zhig bskur/ /sems 'di la bde stong rig rtsal sbor/ /rje khyed dang dbyer med 'grub par zhog /bla ma mkhyen/bla ma mkhyen/bla ma skyes mchog yid bzhin nor bu mkhyen//oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru ma ṇi rā dza sarba sirnyi pha la hūm̐/zhes bzlas mthar rang dang dbyer med blo 'das chos sku'i ngang du bzhag byin rlabs myur 'jug rig rtsal brda rtags ston/ zhag bdun gsol btab rjes su nges par 'dzin/ /rang rig blo 'das ngang nas seng chen rje'i/ /byin rlabs che thob rig pa'i ye shes spel/ //thun mthar hor 'dul dang rta rgyug gsol 'debs dbyangs snyan pos bsgrags par bya'o/ /thams cad 'dul gyi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer gsum la mi pham pas so////

༄༅༅/ /ngo mtshar rtogs brjod brda' gsang nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'o//༄༅༅/ /oṃ susti/ 'dzam gling phan bde grub pa'i rol mo ru/ /ye shes nor bu 'bar ba'i zer phreng gis/ /nag phyogs bdud dgra 'dul la mthu bo che/ /skyes mchog seng chen rgyal pos shis pa stsol/ 1 'dam gyi pad+mo snang ba'i dang po la/ /glog phreng me long dmar po'i dkyil du zhar//'brug sgras dpa' bo rlung gi bang zhon pas//kun kyang dbang du gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ 2 dbang chen cang shes dmar por snang ba yi/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa 'phrul gyi zhags pas bkug /sgyu ma'i gter las srid gsum yo byad 'grigs/ /che rgus mnga' gsol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ 3 stag dang seng 'brug khyung dang glang po'i khyu/ /dregs pa'i chang gis myos bzhin rnam rgyu ba/ /phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du dngar ba'i mthar/ /sbas pa'i zol gyis gshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ 4dwangs pa'i shel las 'phos pa'i gzugs bzhin du/ /du ma'i mdun na sna tshogs nyams kyi klus/ /so so'i yid kyi 'dod pa gsal byed pa'i//sgyu 'phrul rol mo ngom la gsol ba 'debs/ 7 bzhin legs lha yi 53

gling bro bde chen rol mo/ni gu'i tshogs mdun nas/ /zla nyi sgra gcan skar ma'i rgyu ba bzhin//stobs hūṃs rlung gi shed mong rab 'khyugs pas//snyan pa'i ba dan skyod la gsol ba 'debs/ ca dga' skyid nyi zla 'bar ba'i snang ba'i ngogs//phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan drung / /grags pa'i 'brug sgras sa chen 'dar bzhin du/ /rgyal thabs khri chen gnon la gsol ba 'debs/ 7 sgrin las snang ba'i mā khyud dang ni yang / /'dam gyi sbubs nas pad+ma gzhon hūṃ bzhin/ /lhar bcas kun dga'i lus mchog dri ma me+ed//mngon sum snang bar mdzod la gsol ba 'debs/jistobs kyis dregs pa kun kyang 'di yi drung / /cod pan ral pas btud dang lhan gcig tu/ /bdud kyi sde chen pham pa'i cho nge bsgrags/ /dkar phyogs rnam par rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/rtsede nas srid dang zhi ba'i dwangs bcud kun//dbang med 'phrogs pa yid bzhin nor bu'i sku//rtag brtan bgres rgud bral ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel la gsol ba 'debs/ 1༷ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rten 'byung gis//rigs gsum pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul dgra bla'i rgyal/ /yid kyi ut+thal gzhon zhu'i dbus bzhugs nas/ /re 'bras yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dngos grub bstsol/ 11 rab tshes shing khyi hor rla bcu gcig pa'i/ /dmar phyogs mkha' 54

ngo mtshar rtogs baji+od brda' gsang nor bu'i spe long /'gro 'du ba'i tshes bcu las/ /dpa' bo gling la gus pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mi pham rnam par rgyal bas legs par spel/ /lus zungs dga' skyed n+ya gro rda yi 'bras/ /phra yang je bas je cher rgyas pa yi/ /rten 'brel bzang po'i rtog pa bcos min du/ /yang yang skye ba'i rtsal las 'di yang snang / /nyams dga'i bro gar brtsen par 'dod pa'i ngang / /sgyu ma'i gnyid las brda' don sna tshogs shar/ /de tshul brtag na 'di yang rten 'brel gyi/ /mchog bzang g.yul rgyal lha yi rnga dang 'dra/ ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul zhes bya ba/ /'dzam gling tha gru kun na grags pa yi/ /ngo mtshar rta rgyug rtogs pa baji+od pa'i gtam//brda' gsang nor bu'i be long 'di yin no//sarba maṅga lam̐//

༄༅༅/ /hor 'dul gsol 'debos dpa' bo'i gad rgyang bzhugs sa//༄༅༅/ /e ma ho/ rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje'i ngang nyid nas/ /rdo rje khros pa'i sgyu 'phrul me bo che/ /log smon bdud kyi tshang ching bsreg la rngam//skyes mchog dgra 'dul rgyal po rgyal gyur cig /bdud 'dul mnyam pa chen po'i ting 'dzin las/ /dwangs sman ḍā kis rab bskul mkha' 'gro'i glus/ /thugs rje'i glog dmar 'khyug dang chab gcig tu/ /dgra bla'i dmag sprin sdud la gsol ba 'debs/ /shugs chen rlung gis btegs pa'i rta bdun dbang / /mthong ba kun smon yul gyi dbus su shar//re 'dod dga' ba'i mig can pad+mo'i tshal//rdzu 'phrul 'od brgyas 'byed la gsol ba 'debs//dgra bla'i ba dan g.yo ba'i 'abhug sgra dang //lhan gcig rgyu ba sna tshogs nor bu'i sku//zhi dang drag po'i rol rtsed du ma yis/ /lam gyi dgra tshogs 'dul la gsol ba 'debs/ /yid 'phrog dbang gi lcags kyus snying drangs nas/ /srid pa'i mun pa bdud kyi khong du zhugs/ /sgyu ma'i bkod pa chen po'i rol rtsed stong / /brgyud mar ngom par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs//57

gling bro bde chen rol mo/bde chen nor bu'i gter lngan pad+ma'i mtsho/ /thugs rje'i 'od stong 'bar bas ring nas bskyangs/ /sbas pa'i lus mchog rdo rje'i stobs lngan pas//ngo mtshar 'brug sgra sgrogs la gsol ba 'debs//dgra snying dum bur byed pa'i sgyu 'phrul brgya/ /sdig can snying la sning rje'i shugs kyis ngom/ /smag la zla ba bzhin du thugs rje'i mthu/ /'gog med snang bar mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /snying rje'i lcags kyus dbang me+ed bkug nas su/ /mi bzad dug lnga'i me 'bar bdud kyi mgo/shes rab ral gris 'breg par mdzad pa yi/ /ngo mtshar mthu chen ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang phyogs bdud kyi rgyal mtshan rtse nas bsnil/ /yang dag chos kyi rgyal rnga rab tu bsgrags/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal nyi zla'i gzi byin gyis/ /dkar phyogs rgyal khams skyong la gsol ba 'debs//de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rten 'byung gis/ /snying la dgra lha'i rgyal po'i mthu bo nas/ /chos srid legs tshogs 'phel ba'i bar chad dgra/bsam pa tsam gyis ming med thul bar zhog /ci 'di phra mo'i me zhes ma brnyas shig /dus su rlung gis sbar na nags kyi grong / /zla ba'i lce rnon gnam sa'i kha la 'khyug /zhus pa'i rngams sgra 'brug stong bas kyang ldir/ /rab byung zhes grags lnga phrag gsum pa'i khongs/ /thams cad 'dul zhes bgrang bya'i nag pa yis/ /nya ba'i 58

hor 'dul gsol 'debs dpa' bo'i gad rgyang /dus kyi dmar phyogs tshes bcu la/ /sgrub khang bdud las rnam par rgyal ba ru/ /sna tshogs zhus pa 'dzin pa'i sems kyi khams/ /dgra bla'i rgyal por mos pa'i bag chags gzugs/ /dwangs mtshor zla ba bzhin du gsal ba'i tshe/ /mi pham rnam par rgyal bas bris pa dge/maṅga lam̐//

de༅༅/ /ge sar skyes bu chen po rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅༅/ /tshung swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ rang nyid rta mgrin pad+ma dbang chen du gsal ba'i dbu gtsug tu rdo rje thod phreng rtsal bsgom/rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bdud rtsi'i sgrin dkar po lang long du 'khrigs pa'i dbus su dag pa lha yi gzhal yas khang rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang gi dbus su/ gser sbyang nor bus brgyan pa'i khri la za 'og dar gos brtsegs pa'i gdan rgya gram gyi re khas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bdud dang dam sri'i g.yang shun brjid par bkram pa'i dbus su/ dgra bla'i rgyal po ge sar zla ba nya gang ba lta bu lta bas mi ngoms pa'i mdzes sdug lang snu'i gzi byin 'bar ba za 'og sngo skya'i na bza' dang / yang phyam dmar po gsol ba/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa sngo skyas smad dkris pa/ dbu skra sil bur grol ba la 'ja' dang 'od zer 'khyugs pa/ dbu la phyings zhwa zlum po zla ba'i mdangs can/ mdzes pa'i gtsug tu ma bya'i sgro phon dang / me long nor bu dar snas mdzes pa zhal 'dzong ring la mdzes 'dzum 'phro ba/6spro

gling bro bde chen rol mo/snyan cha rin po che'i kong pad dang / mgul pa la gser gā dang be long gis brgyan pa/ /nor bu'i phreng ba dkar dmar dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i do zhal can/ /phyag g.yas za 'og gi 'bol la brten cing //dbang sdud skabs g.yas rdo rje'i lcags kyu zhags pa'i 'phrul thabs kyis srid zhi'i dwangs bcud g.yo zhing 'gugs pa/zhes bsgyur/g.yang skyabs dus na/yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar bsnams pa/zhes bsgyur/mda' mo'i skabs/ phyag g.yas brkyangs pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ zhes bsgyur/bzlog pa'i skabs/g.yas gnam lcags kyi ral gris ma rungs srin po'i mgo 'bregs pa/zhes bsgyur/phyag g.yon lcags gzhu dang lcags mda' 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis lham sna ring gsol zhing rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su skyes bu rdo rje legs pa khye'u dar dkar gyi thod bcings pa/ che/ tog gi rgyan gyis mdzes shing shā rdil thogs pa/ g.yon du sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma g.yu thod gyon zhing phyag g.yas mda' dar dang / g.yon bdud rtsi'i ka pā la dkur bsten pa/ mdun du ma sang spun dgu'i gtso bo dmag dpon mig dmar chen po khros pa'i nyams can/ za 'og dmar ljang gi ber can 'phrul zhags dmar po 'dom du gzhal ba/ de rnams kyi mdun 62

ge sar skyes bu chen po rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub/du gsang ba'i yum chen rnam bzhi mdzes sdug mtshungs pa med pa'i lang tsho can/ 'khor sman phran 'bum gyis bskor ba/ mtha' skor du lha dmag bye ba btsan rgod gnod sbyin klu gnyan sogs dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang / dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung grangs med pa gnam sa bar snang gi khyon kun tu ā+oṃn 'khrigs pa lta bu'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gnas gsum 'gru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i 'od zer dang / bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa steng phyogs lha'i gnas/ a rgyan rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing / rgya dkar nag dang /bod kyi yul/ khyad par mdo khams gling gi yul mkha' sbyod mthong ba kun smon la sogs pa/rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas ge sar skyes bu chen po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis sbyan drangs te mdun gyi dam chig pa la brtan par bzhugs/ tsog trim zhim khyim me mu tra 'bar ra haṃḥ a la li thim par gyur/ zhes sbyan drangs la spos kyi dud pa 'thul zhing rol mo dang bcas pas/ kye/ /dad pa dang ni dam chig gis/ /ge sar skyes bu 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs/ /skyes trim zhim khyim me mu tre 'bar ra haṃḥ a la li la mo: gtung ba khye 63

gling bro bde chen rol mo/a ho ye sirnyi hūm̐ḥ trak+shir khyem: srog dung dung dzaḥ sarba sa ma ya thib thib 'du dung dung yed yed dza dzoḥ zhes 'bod sngags bzlas mthar/badz+ra sa ma ya dzoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ de nas dam bsre ba ni/hūm̐/ /dgongs shig dgra bla'i rgyal po khyod/ /sbyan gzigs pad+ma thod phreng dang / /phrin las dbang po'i sde la sogs/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sbyan snga ru/ /rnal 'byor grogs su khas blangs pa'i/ /zhal bzhes dam bca' ma bsnyel bar/ ༈/ci bcol phrin las ma lus pa//byang chub bar du sgrub par mdzod//badz+ra sa ma ya ra k+shi hūm̐/na mo na ma mi/ zhes phyag bya/ skyes trim zhim khyim sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ/ pakru/ puṣ+pebhu be/a lo ke /ghan+dhe/ne+ewi ngu/zhap+ta/altamaṅgawaṃ/dra bye/liṅga/sap+ta/rat+na/ pañtsa ka ma gu na a m+bi ta k+ta ba lidha pū dzaḥ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod la/ hūm̐/ /rtsa gsu/ma kun 'dus ge sar yid bzhin nor//thugs rje brtse bas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis//sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi/ /dam :jika chags nyams 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib nyes pa'i tshogs/ /'gyod pas bzhags so byang zhing dag pa dang / /mi sgrib tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol/64

ge sar skyes bu chen po rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub//badz+ra sa ma ya āḥ zhes pas bshags nas/ de nas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ hriḥ/rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod pa'i sgrin/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang / /zhal zas rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ khrag chang ar+ghaṃ dbang po'i me tog dang / /chil gsur tsong thug zhun chen sgron me dang / /sha chen rkang gling thod rnga drag po'i rdzas//bdud rtsi sman dang dmar chen rak+ta dang / /ba ling gtor ma dza gad dpa' bo'i phud//bde chen dga' bzhi 'dren pa'i rig ma 'bum//go mtshon yul mkhar zas gos chas rgyan phyugs/ /rgyal srid rin chen nye rdzas nor sna tshogs/ /lha mi'i 'byor ba rgya mtshos kun tu bltams//gtum rngam dmag gi dpung chen sbyin ltar 'khrigs/ /rten g.yab mda' dar dar sna glog ltar 'khyugs/ /drag po'i rnga sgra cha sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /pha rol rgol 'joms mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs//tshe g.yang nor bu'i char pa sil li li/ /'ja' 'od bdud rtsi'i spos sprin ta la la/ /brtse dga' dbang gi 'od dmar khyugs se khyug /bde drod rig pa'i rtsal snang shigs se shig /snang stong sgyu mar rol pa'i ye shes kyi/ /thig le chen po 'khor 'das mnyam brdal ba/ /'dod rgu lhun gyis grub pa'i mchod sgrin 'dis/ /rtsa gsum chos skyong dgra 65

gling bro bde chen rol mo/bla wer ma'i srog /seng chen rdo rje tshe yi rgyal po dang / dgyes yum blon 'bangs drag po'i dpung dang bcas/ /mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa'i dad gus kyis/ /gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang gyur cig /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul chos kyi dbyings su dag /bde stong rdo rje gsang ba'i dam tshig gis/ /rtag tu 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nyid nas/ /myur du dngos grub 'dod rgyu'i dpal stsol cig /ces dang / ge sar skyes bu chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbya gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par bsam/ skyes trim zhim khyim me+e mu tra 'bar ra ha: a la li la mo/ gtung ba khye a ho ye sirnyi hūm̐/ trak+shir khyim sa pā ri wa ra i rda ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes dang / oṃ a kā ro sogs kyi phul/ skye'o trim zhim khyim sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta dra tī ts+tsha hoḥskyes trim zhim sogs rtsa sngags sham du tsoco ā hūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsi 'bul/bstan pa'i bka' srung chen po ge sar 'phrul gyi rgyal po gsang yum blon 'khor dgra bla wer ma srung ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyon gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang 66

ge sar skyes bu chen pordo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub/chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol sogs nas/myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /'dod gsol spyi dang bye brag tu phrin las bcol/bstod pa ni/hūm̐/ /rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma thod dreng dang //rigs gsum zhi dang khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /gcig tu bsdus pa rgyal gshin dam sri'i gshed/ /ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul khyod la bstod/ /thugs rje'i las smon dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /'dzam gling bod kyi rgyal po'i skur bstan pa/ /dran pas tshe g.yang 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol ba/ /rdo rje tshe yi rgyal po khyed la bstod/ /skal bzang gang zhig khyed la dad pa'i mod/ /stobs dpal mthu zhus bskal pa'i me bzhin sbor/ /dgra gdon 'byung po'i bla srog phye mar byed/ /seng chen bdud 'dul dpa' bo khyed la bstod/ /sa gsum che rgu kun gyi cod pan la/ /gang bsam rgyal kha thob par dbang bsgyur zhing / /snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa/ /don 'grub wer ma dkar po khyed la bstod/ /deng 'dir rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /mi 'bral rdo rje gsang ba'i dam chig gis/ /srog gi snying po gcig tu bsdus lags na/ /thugs kyis dgongs nas myur du 'grub par mdzo+od/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i 67

gling bro bde chen rol mo/thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/skyes bu chen po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la a yig dkar po'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba la phog /de las 'od zer sna lnga byung ba rang la thim pas las bzhi'i phrin las bsam pa tsam gyis thogs med du 'grub pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ par bsam la/ dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad de/ skyes trim zhim khyim me mu tra 'bar ra haṃ: a la li la mo: gtung ba khye a ho ye sirnyi hūm̐ḥ trak+shir khyim zhirnya pusnye wa shaṃ mā ra ya sirnyi hūm̐ dza: zhes pa ci zhus bzlas mthar dbyangs gsal/yig brgya rten snying bzla/de nas slar yang gong ltar mchod pas 'thus/ de nas mnga' gsol la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing dar sna bsgrengs/ mchod pa sbos rol mo bcas pas 'di skad gyer ro/ /hūm̐/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las dpa' bo che/ /nag phyogs gdul dka' ma lus 'joms pa'i gnyen/ /dkar phyogs rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /seng chen dgra bla wer ma'i rgyal po khyed/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis byang chub snying po'i bar//re ltos mi 'gyur yid bzhin nor bu'i tshul/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan du/ /dpang bstod mnga' gsol rdo rje'i dam tshig bsre/ /bsam 'grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang du/ /snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi srog gi bdag /rig 68

ge sar skyes bu chen po ldo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub/'dzin chen po 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rtsal/ /rnal 'byor sting gi thig ler mnga' gsol lo/ /dpa' bo chen po bdud dpung dgra 'dul ba//shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu rnam par 'dzin/ /dran pas 'khyul snang 'khor ba'i g.yul 'joms pa/ /ro mnyam rdo rje'i dbyings su mnga' gsol lo/ /srid gsum skye rgu kun gyi cod pan la/ /che btsan 'gran zla med par dbang bsgyur zhing / /snang srid dgra bla wer ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rje btsan dpa' bo khyod nyid mnga' gsol lo/ /lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra ltar//mi 'jigs spobs pa'i bdud rtsi zla med pa/ /myur du snying la stsol bas brin las kyi/ /rno myur thogs pa med par g.yo bar mdzod/ /ces de ltar mnga' gsol nas/ thugs dam bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ slar bdud rtsi'i phud gtor la/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ /dgra bla'i rgyal po rdo rje tshe yi rgyal/ /sngon gyi dam bca' gnyan po'i dus la babs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi re ba chud ma gson/ /las smon 'dras bu bslu ba med par mdzo+od/ /bskal ngan snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'di na ni/ /nag phyogs bdud srin 'byung po'i dpung bskyed nas//theg mchog bstan pa'i mnga' thang smad pa'i tshe/khyed la 'bod do ye shes spyan gyis gzigs/ /mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung glo bur 69

gling bro bde chen rol mo/gdug pa'i rkyen/ /dgra sde stobs shugs dar ba'i nags tshal la//myur du rngam pa dgra 'dul rdo rje'i me/ /dpa' po khyed kyis dam bcas dgongs par mdzo+od/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba dang / /gsang chen bstan la 'khu ba dul du rlog /tshe dpal 'byor pa mi zad gter du bskyil/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod//'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bzhad sgrub sdes//nor 'dzin tha gru kun la khyab pa dang / /bkra zhis las mtha' btsan zhing chos rgyud 'phel/ /chos mthun bsam rgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzo+od//'di nas byang chub bar du bdag cag la/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar/ /rtag tu legs dang sbrod la nyes dang bsnol/ /ci bcol phrin las thogs pa me+ed par sgrubs//snyan grags dge mtshan dkar po'i ba dan gyis/ /srid pa gsum po zil gyis non pa yi/ /ngo mtshar dgra bla wer ma'i stobs shugs kun/ /da lta nyid du bdag la 'jug par mdzod/ /gnas skabs zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las//bsam pa tsam gyis thogs smred 'grub pa dang / /mthar thug khyed thugs gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su/ /rang byung ye shes sku ru 'grub par mdzo+od//ces pa 'di'ang lha rigs bde chen rol pa rtsal gyi dgongs gter 70

ge sar skyes bu chen po rdo rje tshe rgyal gyi bskang gsol 'dod dgu myur 'grub/rdo rje'i tshig don ma nor ba bzhin du/ dpa' bo chen po 'di yi byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma cung zad thob pa mi pham rnam par rgyal bas rang lo nyer brgyad chu bya rgyal zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang por rdzong gsar bkra shis lha rtse'i rang gnas grags pa'i mchod khang du grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang chen a ti yo ga'i bstan 'dzin gyi dbu 'phang srid rtser bstod pa'i rgyur gyur cig7/ sgrub pa byed na stegs bu la/ maṇ+ḍal gter gzhung rtsa ba ltar la/ gtor ma mkhar thabs kyi rtse mor nor bu 'bar bas brgyan pa 'khor bzhos bu bzhi dang ci 'byor gyi mchod rdzas kyis bskor ba/ rtsa gsum gyi rten gtor/bla rdo srog 'khor bkra shis pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor 'du byas la/ rtag ma mthong bar du bsten sgrub bya/ las gang la'ang dmigs pa kha bsgyur bas chog dbang bskur dang bsnyen sgrub las phra mo'i zhal shes bcas gter gzhung gi gzham du gsal byed yig chung du bkod pa ltar ro//'di thin tu bkra shis pas 'don tshad tshe ring ba dang / nor char ltar 'babs pa dang /khyad par snyan grags che zhing go sa bzang po thob pa sogs je bas je bzang du 'gyur ba dang / lhag par nyams rtogs bde drod dang / rtags dang mtshan ma nges par 'byung ba sogs yongs su grags zhing grub pa yid ches pa'i gnas yod/ 'di yang mi pham pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo//71

༄༅༅/ /ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba//༄༅༅/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir sde chen rtsod dang rgyan chen 'gyed//don chen bsgrub sogs dus kyi tshe//nan gyis bya ba la//skyems phud gtor ma dar sna sogs/ /mchod rdzas ji 'byor 'du byas la/ /ting 'dzin ngar bskyed dgra bla gsol/ /las chen 'gags la bslu mi srid/ /dam skong dbang dang dngos grub thob/ /skyems phud bsgrengs shing bar bar rol mo dang bcas 'di skad do/ /ho dgongs su gsol lo/ /rang bzhin skye med chos kyi dbyings las/rnam rol 'gag me+ed thugs rje'i rtsal snang / /rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dang rigs gsum zhi khro'i sgyu 'phrul gcig tu 'dus pa/ /ge sar skyes bu chen po rig 'dzin nor bu dgra 'dul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ yi dam zhi khro'i khyab bdag /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje/chos skyong srung ma'i gtso bo/ /nor lha rgya mtsho'i snying nor/ /dgra bla yongs kyi rgyal po/ /wer ma yongs kyi srog sting / /sde brgyad yongasatrekyi spyi rje/ /dregs pa yongs kyi srog bdag /dkar phyogs yongs kyi kha 'dzin/ /skye bo yongs kyi dgra bla/ /sems can yongs kyi dpal 73

gling bro bde chen rol mo/mgon/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / /ban bon yongs kyi rgyab brten/ /bdud 'dul las kyi dbang phyug /nag phyogs kun gyi gshed ma/ /dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ bdud srin kun gyi zhan pa chen po/ /sku dgyes pa'i gar gyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ /gsung rngam pa'i 'brug sgras khams gsum dbang du sdud pa//thugs 'od gsal gyi klong nas mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa//dran pa tsam gyis byin rlabs dngos grub sgrin ltar 'du ba/ /rdo rje'i rkyang rgod pher po la chib nas bar snang khams su rgyu ba/ ki la 'du zhing bswo la dgyes pa/ /chad la btsan zhing chos la brtsi ba/ /phyag g.yas sba lcags bsam pa'i don grub las dgos 'dod nor bu'i char pa 'beb pa/ g.yon pa'i mdung mo khams gsum dgra 'dul las dgra bla'i ba dan g.yo ba/ /sku la dgra bla'i sku chas rdzogs pa//dgra bla wer ma'i sgrin phung 'phro ba/ /'khor du dkar phyogs kyi chos skyong / gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon/ /dgra bla wer ma cang se'i dmag tshogs ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba/ thugs 'od gsal la spu+os pa'i mtshan ma bral yang / thugs rje smon lam rten 'byung gi dbang las legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin cing bka' yi bya ra mdzad pa/74

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub//'jig rten gyi phud la dgyes shing skye bo'i rgyal kha 'grim pa/ /rten gyi phud la dgyes shing skye bo'i rgyal kha 'grim pa/ dam ldan bu bzhin skyong zhing dgra bla'i tshe g.yang 'be+ebs pa//dam nyams ar la gtod cing don sning rngam zas byed pa/ mchod na 'du zhing sgrub na 'go ba//rbad na myur zhing che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba//bsten pa'i mi la rna mi chung ba//bcol ba'i las la ngo mi lngog pa//bkra shis zhing snying nye ba/ /byin che zhing mthu myur ba/ /las mtha' bzang zhing phug btsan pa//bde nas bde bar byang chub chen po'i gling du 'dren pa/ /dngos grub gnyis kyi gter mdzod chen po/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul la gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi dgra bla chen po la gsol lo/ /rig 'dzin 'dzam gling rgyan mchog la gsol lo//shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu+o can la gsol lo/ /nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo se+ol lo gsal la/ dpa' ba bdud dgra bdud dpung 'dul la gsal la//bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar mdzod la gsol lo/ /dus deng nas byang chub sning po'i bar du re ltos mi 'gyur ba'i rgyal mtshan chen po la chos skyong gi rgyal po seng chen nor bu bsam 'phel khyod bsten no/ /dam tshig 'gyur med kyi sa gzhi la dgra bla'i rgyal po seng 75

gling bro bde chen rol mo/chen ri dbang lhun po khyod bsten no/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam dag gi nam mkha' la wer ma'i rgyal po seng chen nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor khyod bsten no/ /bsten pa'i chos skyong ma nor/ /dad pa'i gnas ma 'chug/mchod pa'i lha ma 'khrul na/ /seng chen yid bzhin nor bu ye shes kyi dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung dang bcas pas/ rtag tu 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i dam chig chen po la dgongs nas/ /dgyes pa'i zhal gyis gzigs zhig /'dzum pa'i sbyan gyis skyongs shig /bzhad pa'i gsung gis brda khrol cig /dga' ba'i thugs kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi gnas lus longs sbyod kyi bdag po mdzod cig /bsgrub pa'i dge mtshan mngon sum du ston cig/bcol ba'i phrin las yid bzhin du sgrubs shig khas blangs pa'i las don yod par gyis zhig /sgo gsum gyi las kyi mtha' dge zhing zhis pas 'tshos zhig /nyams dang rtogs pa skyed cig /ye shes dang yon tan spel cig /tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa snyan dang grags pa phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub rgya chen po dus da lta nyid du stsol cig /rig gsang chos nyid kyi don ston cig /byin rlabs ye shes kyi dbang bskur cig /byas tshad chos su 'gro bar mdzod cig76

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub//'drel tshad don dang lngan par mdzod cig /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod cig /ho//ho/ dgra bla'i rgyal po khyod ni res 'ga' zhi zhing dwangs pa'i nyams can dgyes zhal zla ba ltar ngoms pa/ 'dod dgu'i sgrin las dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen pa/ mthong bas yid 'phrog pa/ dran pas tshe spel ba/sgrub pas dpal skyed pa/ 'chi med tshe yi bdag po/ bdud rtsi'i char pa 'bebs pas/ bde skyid snyan gsum 'phel ba'i g.yang 'phel chen po/bkra shis thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ bskal pa bzang po thams cad kyi gzhi ma/legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rten gnas/dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid chen po/ rgud pa sel ba'i nor bu/ nad 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi/ dman pa rnams la dbugs dbyung ba'i g.yul rgyal lha yi rnga sgra chen po/ rdo rje'i tshe g.yang longs sbyod kyi rgyal po/ 'khor dpal ldan dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo/ /yang cig 'od gsal dag pa'i sku/nam mkha' 'ja' sgrin gur khyim nas/ khyeñtsa bcu drug lang snu'i nyams/dkar gsal dag pa'i shel 'dra ba/ phyag g.yas na rin po che'i sgron me thogs pa/khams gsum sa ler gsal ba/ g.yon na dngul dkar

gling bro bde chen rol mo/me long bsnams pa/ srid gsum lhang nger ston pa/ pho rgyud dpa' bo'i gar stabs byed pa/ mo rgyud dpa' mo'i brda glu len pa/ snang gsal pu yi mnga' bdag kun gsal wer ma'i rgyal po/ srid pa 'phrul gyi gsas mkhar na bzhugs thing / rno mthong 'phrul gyi mngon shes 'chad pa/ snang srid kyi legs nyes ston pa/ shes bzhi mthong brgyad kyi mnga' bdag chen po/ ye shes 'phrul gyi sgron me 'degs pa/ shes rab me lce gsal zhing 'bar ba/ mngon shes rig pa'i gsang sgo 'byed pa/ blo gsal spobs pa'i gter chen 'byin pa/ snang gsal a dkar 'od kyi wer ma/skyes bu seng chen 'phrul gyi rgyal po/'khor kun gsal dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi rgya mtsho/ dar sna ba dan gyi lhab lhab/ rnga dbyangs rol mo'i 'brug sgra/ sna tshogs mthun rdzas kyi mchod spyin/ zhal zas phye mar gyi gangs ri me tog spos dud kyi sprin phung / mchod yon zhabs bsil gyi chu rgyun/snang gsal me long gi 'od khyim/dri chab bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rab 'byams dngos su bzhams pa dang yid kyis sprul pa 'di dag gis dgra bla'i rgyal po chen po ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul a dkar 'od kyi wer ma 'khor dang 78

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub/bcas pa mchod do/ /mnga' gsol lo/ /gzengs bstod do/ /thugs dam bskang ngo / /dpa' skyems 'bul lo/ /nyams pa bshags so//dgyes pa bskyed do/ /thugs dam bskul lo/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi nad gdon bar chad bkra mi this pa sogs rgud pa'i bskal pa ngan pa thams cad nyi mas mun pa bcom pa ltar sol cig /dgra byung na bya thongs shig /dug byung na sman thongs shig /brag lam med la lam gyis shig /chu zam me+ed la zam tshugs shig/bzang dang la khar sprod cig /ngan dang lung khung nas bsnol cig /mi kha dang kha smras ma gtong zhig /rkyen ngan dang bar chad ma gtong zhig/byings na slong zhig /brjed na skul cig bros pa'i ri bo gyis zhig/gab pa'i nags tshal gyis shig /brten pa'i mkhar rdzong gyis zhig/sra ba'i go gyis shig /mi shes pa slob cig /mi mthong ba ston cig nyin gyi bya ra mdzod cig /mtshan gyi mel tshe gyis thig /gzhi la kha 'dzin gyis shig /byes su bsu skyel gyis shig /shes rab ye shes kyi rtsa sgo phyes shig /rig gsang rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo ston cig/spobs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyis shig /she mong bskal pa'i me ltar skyed cig /bde skyid snyan pa'i rol mo 'khrol cig /dpal 79

gling bro bde chen rol mo/yon mi zad pa'i gter sgo phyes thig /nyin la mthong snang gi nyi ma gsal bar gyis zhig /mtshan la rmi lam gyi zla ba snang bar gyis shig/bar skabs nyams snang gi 'od zer 'bar bar gyis shig /phywadang g.yang gi dngos grub chen po dus da lta nyid du stsol cig /srid gsum sa ler ston cig khams gsum lhang nger smos shig /'jig rten gsum gyi legs nyes thams cad rjen cer du yid la ston cig/bsam don gyi re ba mthar phyin par gyis shig /ho/ res 'ga' brjid cing tshims pa'i nyams can/ srid zhi'i dpal yon 'du ba'i gzhal med khang chen por snang srid 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po dang / phyag g.yon zad med gter gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ dpag bsam ljon pa'i dga' tshal la rtse ba/yid bzhin gter gyi bdag po/rin chen nor bu dbang gi rgyal po/ rgya dang bod kyi nor bdag /zas nor 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ mkha' la lha g.yang bdud rtsi'i snran phung sdud pa/ bar snang la mi g.yang dge mtshan gyi na bun 'khrigs pa/sa gzhi la klu g.yang mu zhag gi rgya mtsho bskyil ba rma g.yang 'dod dgu'i char pa 'beb pa/ snyan pa'i ba dan chen po/ grags pa'i 'brug 80

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub/sgra brgya ldan/ srid zhi'i dwangs bcud kyi bdag po/ phywa g.yang longs spyod kyi gzhi ma/ sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i rol mo mthong bas yid 'phrog pa/ mdzes pa'i g.yang chags pa/ bzang dgu'i rgyal kha len cing che dgu'i cod pan 'grim pa/ phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba chen po/ chos srid kyi dbu 'phang dgung bas mtho ba/ mnga' thang gi khyab rgya mkha' las che ba seng chen yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel/ 'khor gter bdag dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung dang bcas pa la bza' ba'i ri bo/ btung ba'i rgya mtsho/yid 'phrog gzugs kyi stangs stabs/snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs brgya ldan/ dri zhim spos kyi dud sgrin/ zhim mngar zas kyi ston chen/bde skyid reg bya'i dga' ston/ mad byung chos kyi mchod pa/ 'dod yon drug ldan gyi sgrin phung / phywa cha g.yang rdzas kyi chol bkram/ mdor na srid zhi'i 'byor pa ma tshang ba med pa 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi dge mtshan dwangs ma'i dpal yon ma lus pa 'ur 'ur mer mer zhig shig yom yom du 'du zhing bde stong rdo rje bkod pa'i mchod snran snang srid 'dod dgu ba rab 'byams su shar ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung dam pa 'dis mchod do/ /mnga' gsol lo/ mnga' gsol 8spro

gling bro bde chen rol mo/lo//gzengs bstod do//thugs dam bskang ngo //dpa' skyems 'bul lo//nyams pa bzhags so//dgyes pa bskyed do//thugs dam bskul lo/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la bcud can gyi zas stsol cig/brjid can gyi gos stsol cig/g.yang can gyi nor stsol cig/snyan pa'i dar phyor cig /grags pa'i dung bus shig /'dod rgu'i char phob cig /phywa g.yang gi rgya mtsho skyil cig /nor dang longs sbyod kyi dwangs ma khyag cig /rigs brgyud dang 'bru nor 'byor pa mnga' thang gong nas gong du spel cig /tshong la khe thob par gyis zhig /rgyan dang rgyal kha thob par gyis zhig /dpa' la dar thogs zhig khrom du dung bus zhig/zhag dang rtsal gyi khe khug cig/mi mnyam pa dang mnyam du chug cig /mnyam pa rnams las khyad du thon cig /bzang rgyu'i rgyal kha bstod cig /legs rgu'i rten 'brel sgrigs shig /che rgu'i mgo bo non cig /'gran 'dod chom la phob cig /mdor na seng chen dgra bla wer ma'i sku shugs dang mthu dpung bdag la zhugs nas phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa dus da lta nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ho/ res 'ga' 'dzum zhing chags pa'i nyams can brtan g.yo kun khyab 'od dmar gyi klong nas rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa'i 82

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub/'phrul thabs kyis srid zhi'i dwangs bcud g.yo zhing 'gugs pa/ sku dgyes pa'i gar gyis srid gsum g.yo zhing yid 'phrog pa/ gsung bzhad pa'i nga ros khams gsum 'gugs zhing bran du byed pa/ /srid zhi'i dpal yon dwangs bcud la rol zhing zur mig rtsen pa/ /mdzes pa'i mdangs kyis dgyes pa'i gar byed cing / snyan pa'i gdangs kyis dga' ba'i glu len pa/ /snod bcud 'od dmar du bzhu ba/ /brtan g.yo sil khrol ltar bsgyur ba/ /dgra bla'i 'brug sgra dgod pa/ /wer ma'i ba dan g.yo ba/ /nyams 'gyur sna tshogs kyi rol rtsed glog ltar g.yo ba/ bde stong rdo rje chags pa'i thugs dang lngan pa/ snang srid kyi yid snang dbang med du 'phrog pa/ /seng chen yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'khor dbang mdzad dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung dang bcas pa rnams la bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho/ 'dod 'byung gtor ma'i ri bo//dmar chen rak+ta'i chu rgyun/ /sdu bzang bsang gi dud sgrin/ /rdo rje bro gar gyi stangs stabs/ snyan pa'i glu yi 'gyur khug /dpa' mdzangs skyes bu'i bro ra/ yid 'phrog rig ma'i glu dbyangs/ bde stong nyams kyi mchod pa/zhu bde lhan skyes kyi rol mo//dgyes 'dzum 'khyud pa'i 'jo sgeg la sogs pa'i snang srid bde stong rdo rje'i rol mor 83

gling bro bde chen rol mo/'byams su klas pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis mchod do/ /mnga' gsol lo//gzengs bstod do//thugs dam bskang ngo //dpa' skyems 'bul lo/ /nyams pa bzhags so/ /dgyes pa bskyed do/ /thugs dam bskul lo/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi lus la yid 'ong gi gzi byin bskyed cig /ngag la bden tshig gi nus pa stsol cig/yid la bde stong gi ting 'dzin sbor cig /mthong tshad dbang du gyis shig /srid gsum zil gyis non cig khams gsum bran du byin cig /mi sting bsgul cig /mi sems g.yos shig /snang ba dbang du bsdus zhig /srid zhi'i dwangs bcud drongs shig /che rgyu'i ral pa gdan du thongs shig /bzang rgu'i dpal 'byor mdun du khug cig/rgyal thabs chen po'i khri la 'khod cig /ji ltar bsam pa'i don lag tu sbrod cig /mdor na snang srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i rdo rje bde ba chen po dbang gi dngos grub ma lus pa dus da lta nyid du stsol cig /ho/ res 'ga' 'jigs byed khros pa'i tshul can/ thabs shes kyi mda' gzhus bdud srin dadral ba'i mtsho mo dkrugs pa/gnam lcags kyi ral gris ma rung srin po'i mgo bo dregs pa/ rdo rje'i mdung gis dam nyam pa'i sning la gzer ba/ drag po'i lcags kyu 84

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub/dgra bo'i mig 'byin pa/ 'bar ba'i gri gug gis dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa/ srung ma'i zi ra khol ba/ sde brgyad gnas la gcun pa/ pho rgyud rbabs ltar sgril ba/ mo rgyud mda' ltar 'phen pa/ wer ma'i skar mda' 'phro ba/ snang srid cha lang rdeb pa/ sbyan mig nyi zla las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ ljags kyi glog dmar las drag sngags kyi thog ser 'phro ba/zhal gyi rba klong las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa/zhangs kyi rlung sgrom las bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub pa/ sku yi dpa' rdzong las dgra bla'i dmag wīn 'khrigs pa/ tshems kyi gangs ri las skyen thang dug mda' 'phro ba/ thugs 'od gsal gyi ngang nas rdo rje khros pa'i me chen 'bar ba/ dgra bo'i zha khrag srog dbugs la cher rngam zhing rol ba/ snang srid kyi khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba/ lan med rdo rje'i mtshon gcig /sgrol byed drag po nor bu dgra 'dul rtsal 'khor dgra gegs 'dul ba'i wer ma rgya mtsho dang bcas pa rnams la dam nyams pa'i dgra bo'i zha yi ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod/ don snying gi nags tshal/ rkang mar gyi 'dam rdzab/ dbug rlangs kyi na bun/ gsur chen gyi dud sgrin/ dbang po'i me+e tog dang bcas te dgra bo'i stobs mthu nus pa tshe dang 85

gling bro bde chen rol mo/'byor pa dang bcas pa 'bar ba'i zhal du stobs pa dam pas mchod do/ /mnga' gsol lo/ /gzengs bstod do/ /thugs dam bskang ngo //dpa' skyems 'bul lo//nyams pa bzhags so//dgyes pa bskyed do//thugs dam bskul lo/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa/bsam sbyor ngan pa/sdang ba'i dgra gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad gang na 'dug pa 'bar ba'i sbyan gyis gzigs la/ 'gugs byed kyi lcags kyus snying la thob cig /sdom byed kyi zhags pas yan lag cings shig /gcod byed kyi ral gris mgo bo chod cig /'big byed kyi mdung gis don sning phug cig/'phen byed kyi mda' mo srog la thob cig /snying bskal pa'i mes sreg cig /lus rdo rje'i mtshon gyis gtub cig /nad mtshon dug gi char phob cig /ltas ngan cho 'phrul gyis spa skongs shig /pho rgyud kyi rtsa ba drung nas phyungs shig /mo rgyud kyi mngal mtha' nas skom cig/bsam sbyor stobs hūṃs kyi dpung shig cig /bsam ngan dug mda' rang bdud du phob cig /sbyor ngan gyi mtshon cha rang gshed du phob cig/lo dang zla bar ma bzhag /zhag dang za ma'i nang sgrol cig /byad phur rbod gtong bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad phyir bzlog cig /dgra 86

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub/nag po sa 'og tu mgo mjug rlog cig /gnyen dkar po'i ngo 'phang dgung du bstod cig /bdag gi mthu stobs nus pa bskal pa'i me bzhin du spor cig /mdor na drag po mngon sbyod kyi phrin las rnams ji ltar bsam pa bzhin du mthar phyin par mdzod cig /ho/ res 'ga' ma nges rdzu 'phrul gyi rol pa can/ /gnam sa bar snang gi khyon kun tu rgyu zhing / rab 'byams phrin las kun la mnga' dbang 'byor ba//bsam pa tsam gyis dngos grub stsol ba//bos pa tsam gyis glog ltar g.yo ba/ /bsgrub pa tsam gyis dam la 'du ba/ /bskul ba tsam gyis las la rgyu ba/ /seng chen rdo rje dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung rnams la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sbrin bdud rtsi dam pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol las byung ba mchog gis mchod do/ /mnga' gsol lo//gzengs bstod do//thugs dam bskang ngo //dpa' skyems 'bul lo/ /nyams pa bzhags so/ /dgyes pa bskyed do/ /thugs dam bskul lo/ /rdo rje'i rkyang rgod pher po la gsol lo/ /gsang ba'i dgyes sde bzhi la gsol lo/ /dmag dpon mig dmar chen po la gsol lo/ /dam can rdo rje legs pa la gsol lo/ /sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma la gsol lo/ /rma rgyal rdo rje drag rtsal la gsol lo/87

gling bro bde chen rol mo//phu bo dung skyong dkar po la gsol lo/ /steng phyogs lha yi dmag dpung la gsol lo/ /pha yab ger mdzo gnyan po la gsol lo/ /bar phyogs gnyan gyi dmag dpung la gsol lo/ /hūṃ bo klu sbrul 'od chung la gsol lo/ /'og phyogs klu yi dmag dpung la gsol lo/ /a ni gung sman rgyal mo la gsol lo/ /snang srid ma mo'i dkyil 'khor la gsol lo//sring lcam tha le 'od dkar la gsol lo//'byung ba lnga yi lha mo la gsol lo/ /rdzu 'phrul klung rta lha bzhi la gsol lo/ /mgron yag dor ma bcu gsum la gsol lo/ /dgra bla'i drwo ma mched dgu la gsal la/ /mgan pa dgra bla bcu gsum la gsal la/ /dgra bla mched gsum lcam dral la gsol lo/ /snod bcud srid pa'i dgra bla la gsol lo/ /phrin las sna tshogs dgra bla la gsol lo/ /'go ba'i lha mgon gnyan po la gsol lo/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dgra bla la gsol lo/ /thugs dkar sum brgya drug cu la gsol lo/ /cong se lam lha gnyan po la gsol lo/ /gnam sa bar gyi wer ma la gsol lo/ /sku 'khor dgra bla'i dmag dpung la gsol lo/ /ḍā ki dwangs sman thams cad la gsol lo/ /dpa' brtul dpa' bo'i sde tshogs la gsol lo/ /bka' 'bangs sbrul pa'i lha dmag la gsol lo/88

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub//bka' sdod snang srid dregs pa la gsol lo/ /snang srid dgra bla wer ma la gsol lo/ /mdor na seng chen dgra 'dul rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes dang las dang 'jig rten gyi tshul 'dzin pa'i chos skyong dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad la dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod snran rgya chen po 'dis mchod do//mnga' gaskusgol lo//gzengs bstod do//thugs dam bskang ngo / /dpa' skyems 'bul lo/ /nyams pa bsh-igs so/ /dgyes pa bskyed do//thugs dam bskul lo/kyi/ye shes kyi chos skyong //las kyi mthu ldan/ /'jig rten gyi mnga' bdag dam pa khyed rnams kyis mkhyen pas dgongs/ /brtse bas gzigs la mthu stobs hūṃs pa chen pos bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar du spung skyob kyi phrin las g.yel ba med par 'dod pa'i don ma lus pa gegs med yid bzhin du sgrubs zhig /bswo bsu+o/ /snang srid dgra bla wer ma'i sprin 'khrigs pa/ /dgyes pa'i gad rgyang 'brug ltar dgod pa'i dbus/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/ /ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul ye shes sku/ /bskal pa'i rlung chen bdun gyi shugs ldan pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul rdo rje'i rkyang rgod pher po 89

gling bro bde chen rol mo/chibs/ /sna tshogs dgra bla'i sku chas 'od du 'bar/ /mi shigs rdo rje sku yi dpa' rdzong la/ /dgra bla wer ma'i dmag dpung 'phro zhing 'du//dran pa tsam gyis dge mtshan rlung shugs spel/ /dad dam 'gyur ba med pa'i yid kyis ni/ /sna tshogs dam rdzas mchod pa'i spren phung gis/ /gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang gyur cig /mnga' gsol gzengs bstod bdud rtsi dpa' skyems 'bul/ /snang stong rdo rje'i thugs kyi ngang nyid nas/ 'du 'bral med par mos ldan bdag la gzigs/ /rigs gsum pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul dregs pa'i rje/ /seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul 'khor bcas kyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la//byin rlobs mthu rtsal hūṃs pa me ltar sbor//snyan pa'i dar chen srid pa gsum na mtho/ /grags pa'i 'brug sgras 'jig rten gsum na khyab/ /pha rol mi mthun phyogs kun zil gyis gnon/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzo+od/ /de ltar dgra bla wer ma dgyes pa yi/ /'brug sgra gang du sgrogs pa'i phyogs der ni/ /phun tshogs bde skyid snyan pa'i char chen 'bebs/ /skal bzang dus kyi dge mtshan nye bar sdud/ /gang la dmigs nas cho ga 'di lta bus/ /dgra bla dpa' bor rtse gcig las bcol na/ /'dod don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /rgyal mtshan 90

ge sar dgra bla'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod phrin las myur 'grub/chen po zhub pa med par bsgreng /sa ma ya/gsol mchod 'di ni wer ma bse ru 'od lngan dkar po'i yid la shar ba ltar rab tshes dbang phyug myos lngan rnam gnon gsum par ci rigs re bris zhing / /lcags 'brug sa ga zla ba'i tshes 1rngu la yongs su rdzogs par grub pa 'dis rgyal bstan rin po che'i dbu 'phang srid rtser bstod pa'i rten 'brel mchog tu gyur cig /skyes bu chen po'i las rim las mi 'bral rtse gcig 'grogs pa yi/ /rdo rje'i go khrab chen po yi/ /gsang ba'i bla rdo 'chang bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ /rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyer ba'i bla rdo chen po'i lag len zab mo ni/ /pha dbang long bu zur bzhi mnyam pa'i logs gcig la gser gyis sdiḥ'adi ltar bris nas/ rdzas sna lnga dang lhan cig sbag /ces pa dgra bla'i rten srin bya'i tsit+ta/ pho lha'i rten shug 'bru/ mkha' 'gro'i rten mgron bu/ nor lha'i rten mu tig khams gsum 'gugs byed rdo khab len bcas rdzas sna lnga'i dbus su gzhug /srog yig mgo mjug ma log pa dar sna lngas dril nas za 'og gi khug mar sba ste/ rab gri lcags/ 'bring zangs/ tha ma shing gi za ma tog tu bcug nas rang sngags kyis rab gnas bya/ sgrub dus dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs/ dus rnams kun tu sgrub pa po'i lus la bcang / 'bral na mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog yong bas gnyan//

༄༅༅/ /gling bro bde chen rol mo bzhugs/༄༅༅/ /dang po bro yi byin pheb ni/ /mos gus gdung ba'i yid mchog gis/ /rab bskul zhi zhing dga' ba'i nyams/ /snyan 'gyur tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu//glu ni 'di ltar blang bar bya/skyes/ lo 'u la a ho ya sogs/ mi rje seng chen lha yi nor bu/ /dgra bla wer ma'i dpung dang bcas te/ /bag dro gzi byin thibs se byon nas//g.yas gral lha yi bro la bzhugs zhog /pho rgyud dpa' ba'i byin chen phob zhog/a ho ya sogs//bu yis pha chen brjed pa mi srid//ngas ni mi brjed gsol ba 'debs so/ /yid la seng chen rgyal po dran nas/ /rkang pa'i bro dang lag pa'i gar stabs/ /ngag gi gdung dbyangs lhang lhang sgrogs na//mkhyen pa'i nyi ma gsal ba'i lha sras//brtse ba'i zla ba rgyas pa'i mi rje/ /byin rlabs glog ltar myur ba'i seng chen/ /sku rje don grub wer ma dkar po/ /'dzum pa'i zhal ras ston la byon shog /snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs sgrogs la byon shog /dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs la byon zhog /byin rlabs brda rtags ston la byon zhog /phrin las byin chen phob la byon zhog /65 ho ya sogs/lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 93

gling bro bde chen rol mo/'bul na/ /ma g.yel thugs rjes dgongs shig nor bu/ /pha yis bu de brjed pa mi srid/ /ma brjed yod na da lta phebs shog /phebs nas bkra shis byin rlabs mdzod cig/a ho ya/a ho ya/le'u tshan dang po'o//de nas bud med rnams kyis ni/glu ni 'di bzhin blang par bya/oṃ/stong nyid lha mo chos kyi mtsho mo/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas te/ /bag dro gzi byin thibs se byon zhog /g.yon gral lha yi bro la bzhugs zhog /mo rgyud mdzes pa'i byin chen phob shog /bu mos a ma brjed pa mi srid/ /ngas ni mi brjed gsol 'debs so/ /yid la dwang sman ḍā gī dran nas//rkang pas bro dang lag pas gar thabs//ngag gis gdung dbyangs lhang lhang sgrogs na/ /mkhyen pa'i nyi ma gsal ba'i mkha' 'gro/ /brtse ba'i zla ba rgyas pa'i yum chen/ /byin rlabs glog ltar myur ba'i dwangs sman/ /dgyes yum bkra shis gsang ba'i lha mo//'dzum pa'i zhal ras ston la byon zhog /snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs sgrogs la byon zhog /dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs la byon zhog/byin rlabs brda rtags ston la byon shog /phrin las byin chen phob la byon zhog /lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul na/ /ma g.yel thugs rjes dgongs shig sgrol ma//ma yis bu mo brjed pa mi srid//ma 94

gling bro bde chen rol mo bzhugs/brjed yod na da lta phebs zhog /phebs nas bkra shis byin rlabs mdzod cig/a ho ya/a ho ya/zhes so//de nas mchod cing bstod pa'i glu/ /pho mo khyad bed ci bder blangs//bkra shis dar gyi 'phyangs 'phrul thogs/ /sgeg cing 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis ni/ yid 'phrog ngag gis blang bar bya/ āḥ sku rje seng chen yid bzhin nor bu/ /rtsa gsum dgra bla'i sprin daXng 'khrigs pa/ /bde chen dngas sman ḍā ki'i tshogs dang / /dgyes bzhad chags pa'i nyams 'gyur g.yo zhing / a la la ho/ a la la ho/ byin rlabs gzi byin 'bar bar bzhugs la/ /'dir 'tshogs dad ldan bdag cag rnams kyis//gnas lus longs sbyod mchod par 'bul na//brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes par mdzod cig/a la la sogs/mdzes mdzes lus kyi bro gar stangs stabs/ /snyan snyan ngag gi glu dbyangs 'gyur khug /dung dung sems kyi dad gus gdung shugs/ /yang yang seng chen rje la mchod do//a la la sogs/ sngon tshe ser po hor gyi sa nas/ /stong nyid mgar bza' chos kyi sgron mas/ /dgra bla'i sku chas khyed la gsol bas//bstan dgra thul pa'i rten 'brel 'grig song / /a la la sogs/ sngon tshe dwangs sman mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / /lha klu mi yi dregs ldan 95
