gling bro bde chen rol mo/dang yum 'gog bza' lha mo gnyis kyi sras su bltams/ sku na chung ba'i dus su sbas tshul dang dzu 'phrul gyi rtul zhugs kho na bskyangs te mi min 'byung po'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad pa dang dus gcig la sprul pa'i sku mi gcig pa du ma ston cing rnga g.yab gling du rje 'bangs rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs gral du phebs te gu ru rje las dbang chos gsan pa dang / mdo khams gnas chen rnams su sgrub pa mdzad tshe dngos nyams rnams su lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyis zhal gzigs lung bstan thob/ lhag par du mtsho skyes ma hā gu ru'i ye shes skus rjes su bzung zhing gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor lnga'i dbang dang khyad par drag po'i phrin las bka' babs lung bstan cing mnga' gsol ba ltar/rang don du lta sgom gyi rtsal chen rdzogs te grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ gzhan don phrin las rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mo phyes te log smon bdud dgra rnams drag po mngon sbyod kyis bsgral ba'i dus la bab par gzigs nas gling pha khu phu hūṃ'i bka' bgros bzhin gling dkar gyi gser khri'i mnga' bdag de mgyogs pa'i rgyal la bzhag ste rta rgyug 'gran rtsod kyi khrod nas rnam par rgyal/ seng lcam 'brug mo khab tu bzhes/ gling stod smad bar gsum bcas kyi dpa' rtul sum bcu spro36

gling rje ge sar rnam thar bsdus pa/dwangs sman yongs nas/ rten 'brel gyi dga' ston zab rgyas ngang gser khrir mnga' gsol ba dang / mon 'jang hor bdud sogs phyogs bzhi'i bdud chen bzhis gtsos pa'i rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong phran grangs med bcas mngon spyod drag/ po'i phrin las kyi bsgral te dbang du bsdus/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzam gling mtha' dbus kun tu khyab brdal du spel zhing / dkar phyogs kyi dbu 'phang dgung la bstod de skye 'gro bde la bkod/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las ba'i'i sgo nas gdul bya'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba dang / lhag par du dgra lha'i rgyal po'i tshul gyis rlabs chen bstan 'gro'i don du phrin las kyi mdzad pa rgyun ma chad par dus deng sang gi bar du 'jug bzhin pa dang /de ltar skye 'gror 'tsho ba'i log smon bdud sde'i rigs rnams drag po'i dmag gi stobs shugs kyis tshar bcad/ sku tshe smad la 'jig rten gyi khams su gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang mthun par zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / khyad par nges don rdzogs pa chen po'i chos 'khor bla na med pa bskor te 'gro khams dong sprugs kyi phrin las mkha' khyab tu brdal bar modzad/ de nas sku dngos kyi mdzad pa re zhig grub nas gdul bya gzhan dan du dgangs nas dgung grangs gya brgyad rwa37

gling bro bde chen rol mo/pa phyi lo 1127shing mo sgrul gyi lor phyi rabs pa rnams la lung bstan brtse ba'i zhal gdams sogs rim par stsal te sa g.yos pa dang sgra grags pa/pho brang seng phrug stag rtse'i phyi nang thams cad du 'ja' 'od kyis khengs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te 'ja' lus chos sku'i klong du gshegs so//dwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang ṅga/ gcung 'jam sprul sku dreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer zhabs kyis mdzod pa'i 'dzam gling skyes mchog gling rje ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyi rtogs brjod 'chi med lha yi rnga sgra zhes bya bar zhog ldebs 14cabazhugs pa dha ram sa la'i bod kyi dpe mdzod khang nas 1rtseji4 lor dpar skrun 'grems spel gnang 'dugaspyir gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i rnam thar rdzong chen 1rngudang phyi gling 21sogs/ bod kyi skyes chen du ma nas ge sar gyi rnam thar sgrub thabs las tshogs spyi dang / mi pham rin po che lta bu dang skyabs rje bdud 'joms 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rje nas mdzad pa'i rnying ma'i chos 'byung sogs shin tu mang ba'i thugs snang yod pa rnams nas phyag dbe de rnams gzigs gnang yod pa zhu/spro38

gling bro bde chen rol mo/dge'i phyi blon gyi khongs gtogs dpon phran du ma yod pa'i nang tshan ru dpon chos dar gyi sras mo sring chung ni rje 'di'i yum ste/ de ltar rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs par rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me pho rta (kro846)lor gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin yul mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug tu grags pa'i nang chen zla klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram yul skyong dge bsnyen chen po rdza rgyal rdo rje 'phen phyug gis bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas ya chu'i ding chu zhes par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sbrul pa'i pad+mo bzhad/nyid kyi khya bo dbon bla ma sgrub mchog pad+ma dar rgyas kyis mi pham rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ sku na chung dus nas dad pa dang nges 'byung shes rab dang sning rje sogs theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi zhus pa thams cad lhan skyes su mnga' zhing yi dam 'jam dpal zhi drag dang chos skyong ge sar gnyis las bsam rgyu gzhan med pa zhig yod ces sleng /dgung grangs bcu nas 'bri klog la thogs pa me+ed cing ljags rtsom sogs ci rigs gnang /dgung grangs bco lnga'i skabs dbyangs 'char gyi dpe rnying zhig la zhag shas gzigs te 'jam dpal la gsol ba btab pas ma lus par mkhyen/ 'ju nyung ri khrod du zla ba bco brgyad du spro40

dpal 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i rnam thar bsdus pa/'jam dpal smra seng sgrub cing ril bu'i las sbyor mdzod pas rtags mtshan khyad par can brnyes/ de nas bzung mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa ma bslab par mkhyen cing gzhung gang gzigs la mi mkhyen pa ma byung bas bshad lung tsam las slob gnyer bslab sbyang ma myong bar gsungs/lab skyabs mgon dbang chen dgyes pa rdo rje'i mdun nas ma ti'i 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang dang chos skyong ge sar gyi srog gtad sogs gsan pas gzhung nas bshad pa ltar grub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon du gyur pas mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo ba'/da/'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam sprul dpal sprul rin po che o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po las zhag lnga'i khongs su sbyod 'jug shes rab le'u gsan pas tshig don mtha' dag daphyis phyin par thugs su chud cing sher ñtsāka sogs kyang mdzod/ khyad par tshe rabs du ma nas 'brel ba'i rigs kyis bdag po mtshungs med 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyis bsnyen pas nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur dgongs te thog mar ma ti'i 'jam dkar gyi rjes su gnang bas chos sgo phyes/ snga rjes ci spro41

gling bro bde chen rol mo/rigs par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gtsug lag gi sgo du ma dang nye brgyud du byon pa'i gzhung khyad 'phags rigs dang / gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol rgyab brten man ngag phyag bzhes kyi dmar khrid sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i gdams pa mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du stsal/'jam mgon blo bros mtha' yas/ mkhan chen pad+ma rdo rje/ 'bum gsar dge bshes ngag dbang 'byung gnas sogs gsar rnying ris med kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel spyi dang bye brag tu rnying ma bka' gter gyi skor sogs kun mkhyen bla ma'i nye brgyud thun min rnams gsan pas don mtha' dag thugs la rang rdol gyi tshul du byung bas gzhung lugs rab 'byams la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa thogs pa med par gyur te/gsung rab zab dang rgya che ba'i tshul mtha' dag rton pa bzhi dang mi 'ab/la bar so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i tshul gyis thugs su chud pa dang rang byung ye shes kyi snang ba mkha' dang mnyam par dbang 'byor bas spobs pa'i gter chen po brgyad thob/rje 'di la snga phyir gsar rnying gi mkhas pa mang pos rtsod pa byed pa byung yang kun mkhyen chen pos rjes su bzung zhing byin rlabs

dpal 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i rnam thar bsdus pa/snying la zhugs pa'i stobs kyis dpal gsang chen snga 'gyur ba'i zab gnad mtha' dag bde blag tu rtogs pas phas rgol gyi zhal la rdo rje'i rgyas 'debs par byas te smra ba bcad pa dang grags pa nyams pa ngo tsha ba gsum byin te/ dpal phyogs glang chos grags yab sras sogs kyi bzhed pa'i seṅge'i khri la mkhas pa 'di bzhugs su gsol ba'i 'os su gyur te/ snga rjes su rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che lan bdun bsnyan 'gyur sogs cha tshang bar dpe gzigs gnang / sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor sogs tshig gi brjod pa phun sum tshogs shing lung dang rigs pa'i man ngag gi zab gnad mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa'i dgongs 'grel bstan bcos mang po ljags rtsom mdzad/sgrub pa kho na la thugs gzhol te 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba dang / chos brgyad gyi spros pa ring du dor nas sku tshe hril por sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mdzad/ khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po ka dag khregs chod dang lhun grub thod brgal gyi nyams bzhes mthar phyin pas chos nyid yid dpyod du ma lus par mngon sum tshad la phebs te/ snang spyod sku dang ye shes kyi rol pa rang snang longs sku'i zhing khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i dag pa rab 'byams kyi gzigs mo 'byams su klas/ nang gi rtsa khams ye shes sgrin gyi spro43

gling bro bde chen rol mo/'khor lor yongs su dag pa'i stobs kyi sgom byung gi mkhyen rab klong nas rdol te zab don mtha' dag dgongs pa'i klong nas rang rdol ba'i dgongs gter bstan bcos kyi tshul du bkod/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i theg mchog chos kyi dga' ston myong ba'i slob tshogs grangs las 'das pa byung bas nang nas gtso bo rdo grub chen rin po che/ gter ston bsod rgyal/ rdzogs sprul lnga pa chen po/ dge mang skyabs mgon/mkhan chen pad rdor/ kaḥthog si tu rin po che/ zhe chen rab 'byams/dpal yul rgya sprul/ karma yang sprul/ rgyal tshab sprul sku/ dpal spungs si tu/ gling rje drung / dge mang dbon bstan 'dzin nor bu/ mā ra sprul sku/mkhan yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma lung rtogs/ a 'dzoms 'brug sprul/rtogs ldan shākya shrī/ngor slob dpon/ dgu rong sprul sku sogs zhe rdzogs/kaḥdapal/ dpal spungs/ sde dge dgon chen/ a mdo reb kong sogs kyi sa dge bka' rnying gi bla sprul mkhan chen sngags 'chang / tshe blos btang gi bya bral rnams dang sa skyong sde dge dang gling tshang rgyal pos gtsos rgya bod hor sogs kyi rgyal blon che dgu 'byor ldan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis mtshon te thugs brtses bzung ba glangs med do//mthar zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par dgongs te/ mkhan po kun spro44

dpal 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i rnam thar bsdus pa/dpal sogs la zhal gdams kyi rim pa rgya cher stsal ba dang bcas dgung grangs re bdun pa sbyi lo 1rtse12 chu byi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i nyer dgu'i nyin phyag mnyam bzhag chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad de/ gdod ma'i zhi dbyings su gshegs so//

da༅༅/ /rgyal zur dwa sgreng rin po che'i rnam thar bsdus pa/༄༅༅/ /bod kyi srid skyong rgyal zur dwa sgreng a chi thu ho ling ho thog thu no man han sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal mtshan mchog ni phyi lo 1rtse12 lor dwags por sku 'khrungs/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog nas dwa sgreng sku phreng bzhi pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin khri gsol gnang /phyi lo 1rtse34lor zla ba 1 tshes 1༷ nyin gangs ljongs skyong ba'i rgyal tshab byed pa por mnga' gsol/ 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jo gsar bzhengs gnang zhing 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog ngos 'dzin gdan zhus dang / srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren sku 'phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i rje btsun 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang bsgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i sde dpal bzang po zhes pa'i mtshan gsol dang / zhabs brtan gsol 'debs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po zhes pa brtsams pa sogs bod mi rnams kyi bsam 'dun bskangs ba sogs bod gangs can par chos srid mdzad phrin zla 147

gling bro bde chen rol mo/bed pa bskyangs/1rtse4༷lo mjug srid skyong bi khri las bshol/bro dpon nor bzang gi gcen po skyabs rje zhing sgrub rin po che dang /skyabs rje bya bral sangs rgyas rdo rje rin po che'i sku mdun nas rdzogs chen gyi chos skor gsan/ zhing sgrub rin po che nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng la sku tshe tshe sgrub phul/nor bzang gi gcung po 'jam sprul rin po che nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng mchog gi lcam sring nyi mchog khab tu bzhes/ smug po lngong nor bzang la gling bro'i brgyud 'dzin bro dpon du/ bskos par mdzad/'jam mgon mi pham mchog gi chos sde gling bro bde chen/ rol mo ngo mtshar shis pa'i gad rgyang zhes pa la zur 'jug kha skong dang nyams gso sogs mdzad pa ma zad ma 'ongs pa la phyi rgyal/ sogs la dar 'phel gyi lung bstan bcas gsung / rgyal zur dwa sgreng rin po che mchog nas mi pham rin po ches mdzad pa'i gling bror zur 'jug kha snon mdzad pa par shing du brkos nas de skabs 'khrab ston pa tshang mar bgos 'grems kyis blo 'dzin skyor sbyangs byed bcug /rgyal zur mchog spro khang nang bzhugs skabs sku 'khor thams cad kyi gling bro'i mchod pa phul/ chibs pa g.yu 'abhug lags dang / rnam sras lags/skar mda' lags gsum la rin chen rgyan cha gsol nas mi pham 148

rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i rnam thar bsdus pa/gyis mdzod pa'i gsol ka bsdus pa gsung srol 'dug /g.yu 'brug lags nas zhabs rjes kyi grub rtags yang bzhag yod 'dug /zla ba gsum re la/ chibs pa sum bcu la rin chen rgyan cha gsol nas mi pham gyi gsol ka rgyas pa gsung srol 'dugarwa sgreng rgyal zur sku na chung dus skabs kyi grub rtags mdzad pa rdo khog kha dam pa de bzhino rgyal ba sku phreng 13 mchog gi sku gdung nang gzungs gzhug phul yad pa byung 'dug/mthar phyi lo 1rtse47 lor glo bur sku zhi bar gshegs so/ /'dir glingo bro'i 'brel yod dang ngo spu+od mdzad pa mdor bsdus tsam yin pa'i dgangs 'jags zhu/rgyal zur rwa sgreng gi rnam thar rgyas pa mang po yod 'dra/ yin yang so sos thugs snang yod tshe zhib 'jug sogs kyi ched du bkod pa'i deb la gzigs gnang yod pa zhu/

da༅༅/ /rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang ngo spu+od bsdus pa/༄༅༅/ /gling bro'i brgyud 'dzin rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang mchog ni mdo stod ras tshang sgom sde nang chen stag gsar dpon tshang gi mnga' khongs gtam gzhung 'bol dace+o/'i nang gling stag ru spug po ldong gi rus brgyud yab stag gsar dkan mchag bstan dar dang / yum dpan bza' dkar mdzes lha mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i me rta/ phyi lo 1rtseXcu lor sku 'khrungs/ gcen zhing sgrub rin po che ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'gyur med (1894—kro973) zhabs dang / gcung sa skya'i chos sde stag gsar dgon thub bstamyo/ chos 'khor gling gi 'jam sbrul sku phreng gsum pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer (kro9spro0—1987)mchog yin/ da dung sku mched bgres shos phu bo sangs rgyas dang /lcam sring me tog sgron dkar/ lcam sring sgrol ma dbyangs mtsho/ phu bo nges don/lcam sring mkha' 'gro bcas yod/ mkhan chen gzhan dga'i dngos slob zur mang mkhan chen pad+ma rnam rgyal dang grub dbang bkra shis chos 'phel rin po che (spro860—spro943)sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma'i drung nas mdo sngags rig 15spro

gling bro bde chen rol mo/gnas kyi skor sogs gsan bsam mdzad/ lhag par du grub dbang rdzogs chen sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang /rdzong sar mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros sogs kyi drung nas dbang lung man ngag zhus/dam pa'i skyes chen du mas bstano 'dzi+on gyi skyes bu zhig tu ngos 'dzin gnang / sku chung dus nas glu bra sags sgyu rtsal mtha' dag la rang bzhin gyis nang byan chub pa dang rigs pa rtul zhugs kyis sbyod pa skyong mkhan zhig yod par grags/bro dpon nor bzang dang sku mched zhing sgrub rin po che dang 'jam sprul rin po che rnam gnyiso thog mar pha yul mdo khams nang chen nas 'dam gzhung du bla ma a rgyan gzhan phan mtha' yas mjal sar phebs/phyis su ge/cen po zhing sgrub rin po che dang gcung 'jam sbrul lam shel dkar rin po che sogs dang lhan du lha sar gnas skor phebs rjes thang lha shel phug la sku mtshams bzhugs skabs rwa sgreng gter ston nas chos bdag rtsad gcod stabs rwa sgreng phyogs su gdan 'dren zhu ba dang lhan cig rgyal zur dwa sgreng rin po che'i zhabs la btugs/sku mched phu bo zhing sgrub rin po che dang zhu bo 'jam sprul rin po che spro52

dwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang ngo sprod bsdus pa/rnam gnyis nas rgyal bstan spyi phan ched gdan sa se ra theg chen gling gi 'dzin khongs dbu ru byang phyogs 'dam rag chen sgrid lhar (deng rgya 'og lha sa kron chus/'dam gzhung rdzong /dbu ma zhang nang yod ) 'du 'dzes dben pa'i sa khul du 'dus tshogs skya ser sngags btsun brgya phrag tsam gyi bsti gnas ka ba 2༷ can zhig rab rgyal chu lug 1rtse43lor gsar bskrun gnang ba dang / rgyal zur dwa sgreng sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rgyal mtshan (19spro2—1947) mchog nas de skabs sgrub sde der kun bzang mdo sngags gling (sgrid lha dben khrod dam rag chen ri khrod yang 'bod ) zhes pa'i mtshan gsol gnang ba ma zad/ sgrub sde'i bca' yig kyang stsal ba bcas kyi gzigs skyong thob/ phyogs mtshungs chos sde chen po se ra theg chen gling gi bla spyi nas kyang rgyab gnyer bka' gtan gnang ba dang / lo ltar 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i sku'i tshe sgrub zhu dgos phebs pa ltar smin sgrub mdzad pa ma zad/ skyabs rje zhing sgrab rin po che dbu bzhugs thog zla ba dang po'i nang zhing sgrab nyin rgyongs 7chag med sgrub chen tshogs pa gnang / ༄sku'i gcung po 'jam sprul nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po cher ngo spu+od gnang / rgyal zur mchog nas las smon rten 'brel dus su smin pa dang 153

gling bro bde chen rol mo/gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i gdung rgyud khyad par can yin bcas gsungs te/nor bzang gling bro'i brgyud 'dzin du mnga' gsol mdzad/nor bzang nas kyang rgyal zur dwa sgreng mchog gi bka' slob lam ston bzhin gling bro'i cho ga'i gar stabs dbyangs dang bcas pa gtan 'bebs mthar phyin par mdzad/ rwa sgreng sa gnas kyi gling bro 'khrab ston pa skyes pa pho mo gzugs mdzes bzang la legs pa sogs bdams sgrug gnang ba'i slob ma rnams la'ang 'khrab 'khrid mdzad pa sogs gling bro'i 'khrab ston skor la ngo mtshar ba'i mdzod pa bskyangs/ de ltar rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i bka' dgongs bzhin gling bā+o'i brgyud 'dzin dar spel 'gan 'dzin sogs la thugs khur che cher bzhes nas mnyes pa'i zhabs gtogs mthar phyin par bsgrubs/gzhis bod dang phyis rgya bal gang du'ang khong gis mi tshe gcig ring yi dam gyis bsnyen tshad long pa'i rtags su nad par sngags chus phan thog rtag tu mdzad/ rgyal zur dwa sgreng rin po ches mtshams re sbro snang sku rtsed kyis phyag mda' tsha gzigs bskyon skabs bod dngul ṭam dkar mdzub bar thog nas g.yo 'gul med par bzhengs thub mkhan bro dpon nor bzang dang gzhan gcig ma gtogs ma byung na bla 154

rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang ngo sbrod bsdus pa/mar rtse gcig dad cing zhe rtsa brtan cing blo khog yod pa'i grags pa thob/ gling bro 'khrab ston nyin der nam rgyun gyi gang zag min par bro dpon rang gis yi dam lha bskyed sogs kyis mthu zhus sam khrom pa rnams kyis mthong tshul du zhabs sa la me reg cing / ngo mtshar rngam brjid mjal spro ba zhig yod skad pa kun gyis gleng /rab rgyal zhing bya/ 1rtse47 lor rwa sgreng du gling bro 'khrab ston thengs gsum pa zhu skabs bro dpon nor bzang gi bu mo dbyangs 'dzo+oms dgung lo 12 tsam las ma phebs kyang rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po ches dbyangs mdzoms ma 'ongs par bro dpon byed dgos na da lta nas 'khrob ces ma 'ongs sngon gzigs rten 'ablel 'grigs pa'i bka' rjen phebs pa ltar phyag bzhes bskyangs/ ma zad sbro khang la bzhugs skabs rwa sgreng rgyal zur kyis dgongs/ bzhes bzhin sku 'khor thams cad gling bro'i mchod pa phul srol yod 'dugadwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang la lcam ye shes lha mo zhes sku gcen zhing sgrub bla brang gi sbyin bdag bu mor snga rjes sras sros lnga byung ste/shing phag lo ma dbyangs 'odzoms/ sa yos lo pa 'jam dbyangaso grags pa/ lcags sgrul la pa bsam gtan chas grags/ chu lus/ la 155

gling bro bde chen rol mo/ma skal bzang chos sgron/ sa byi lo ma longs sbyod mtsho mo bcas 'khrungs/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa la'ang bu bkra shis/ tshe ring dbyangs 'dzoms/bu bsod nams/chos 'dzoms bcas dang /bsam gtan chos grags la'ang bu pad+ma dgra 'dul/ phrin las dpal 'byor/shes rab 'od zer/ tshe ring rdo rje/ tshe g.yang rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin mtsho mo/nyi ma mtsho skyid/ mtsho mo/ bu bstan 'dzin bcas/ skal bzang chos sgron la ngag dbang 'jigs med/ kun bzang dpal mo/ tshe g.yang sgrol ma/'jam dpal rgya mtsho bcas/ longs spyod mtsho mo la bu tshe brtan rdo rje dang bu mo pad+ma sgrol dkar bcas rim par 'khrungs so//1rtse71 lor rgya dmar bod la lhags rjes rim bzhin 'dam gzhung du gnam thang gsar bzo byas stabs zhing sgrub bla brang lhan rgyas byang gnam mtshor gnas bskor phebs/ zhangs zab phu'i gnas dang / 'ug pa lung zhes mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi bu slob bdun gyis rdzu 'phrul 'phur lding byed pa'i gnas sogs mjal/ gnas bskor phebs dus sgrid lha dben khrod kyi bu slob skya ser mang po mnyam du bcar/rin po che rnam pa gtsang nas rim bzhin mang yul skyid grong gi gnas dang /de nas bal yul gyi gnas rnams mjal/ bal yul nas sbas yul 156

dwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang ngo sbrod bsdus pa/'bras ljongs su phebs/ rgya dmar bod la btsan 'dzul byed shugs che ru phyin par brten sbas yul du'ang rgyun ring tsam bzhugs 'char mdzad kyang slob ma rnams nas u nan chen pos bod la gdan drangs/gtsang pa slob ma rnams kyis gtsang rang la bzhugs rogs zhes gsol ba btab pa ltar shangs dang thob rgyal khyal dus yun lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ de nas zang zang lha brag tu gnas gzigs phebs pa dang rim bzhin skyid grong gi gnas rnams mjal bzhin bal yul du slar yang phebs/1rtsecaX lor dha sar 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mjal sa/ra bcar/ de nas/ ka sbrug tu 7skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po ches rin chen gter mdzo+od bka' dbang bstsal ba gsan sar phebs/ slar yang dha sar phyir log /de rjes gar zhwa mkha' 'gro'i gling la lo gcig lhag bzhugs/de nas sim lar phebs/ 1rtseca4 lor rgya gar lho shar o re sa'i gzhis chags su skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po ches rnying ma'i gzhis chags tshugs kyi yod skor gsan 'phral gzhis khongs su 'dzul zhugs byas/1rtsecu4 lor o re sa'i gzhis sgar du re zhig gtan chags byung 157

gling bro bde chen rol mo/rjes bod nang rgya dmar gyis bod kyi mi rigs dang / chos/ rig gzhung rtsa med bzo bzhin par brten gling bro de yang ming gi lhag mar gyur la nye bar brten rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang mchog dang sras mo dbyangs 'dzoms gnyis nas gling bro'i me ro blangs bar thugs 'khur che bzhes bzhin re bskul byung tshad la sku ngal khyad bsad dang phyogs ris med par thog ma skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che mchog gi chos tshogs gzhis sgar gsum pa dang /de nas a ri ba bud med lin lar nar bya ba/ de nas ri pa bla brang dang gzhis sgar bzhi pa gnyis pa lnga pa dang / de nas dha ram sa la'i bod gzhung zlos gar tshogs pa'i slob dge las rogs bkra shis don grub (bkras chung ) sogs la slob 'khrid daphyis phyin mdzod nas snga rjes su 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che rnam gnyis la gzigs 'bul zhus/ mdor na 1rtseca4 nas sku tshe'i 'phen pa ma btang bar gling bro'i khrab khrid bzhed srol rgyun mthud rtag 'grus mdzad/rwa sgreng bro dpon nor bzang zhing la ma phebs snga nyin nas da ring nga ni skya mi lngas bsu ma slebs byung / da nga 'gro ran gsungs pa dang chab gcig ha ha zhes bzhad/spro58
